listings.name: Aptus Pharma Limited
listings.about: Aptus Pharma Limited engages in the marketing and distribution of finished pharmaceutical formulations. The company operates through four divisions: Aptus Pharma, Pioneer division which includes marketing of acute therapies including general anti-infectives, pain management, antacids, and gastrointestinal drugs; Aptus CD Care, Cardiac Diabetic division which includes marketing of chronic therapies, including anti-hypertensive, anti-diabetic, and lipid-lowering; Aptus Wellcare offers wellness and nutraceutical products, over-the-counter (OTC) formulations, and personal care products; and Aptus Global, export division engages in exploring and developing opportunities in overseas markets, semi-regulated and emerging countries. It also offers anti-infectives, gastrointestinal, antacids, anti-allergic and respiratory, nutritional supplements, pain management, neuro-psychiatric, cardiovascular, antidiabetic, lipid-lowering, and general wellness products. Its products are available in balms, capsules, drops, gels, injections, lotions, ointments, powders, sachets, softgels, solutions, suspensions, syrups, tablets, and vials. It distributes the products through clearing and forwarding agents. Aptus Pharma Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Rajkot, India.

listings.name: Aritas Vinyl Limited
listings.about: Aritas Vinyl Limited engages in the manufacturing and supplying of technical textile including artificial leather using transfer coating technology in Greece, Oman, UAE, Sri Lanka, USA, and India. The company's products include Polyurethane Synthetic leather and PVC-coated leather or polyvinyl chloride leather. The company's products are used in a wide range of products in diffent industries, such as seat covers, door covers, dashboards, shoe uppers, shoe lining and insoles, sandals, furnishing and Upholstery, purses, bags and briefcases, diary covers and stationery items, garments, belts, automotive, and wallets. The company sells its products to distributors, wholesaler and manufacturers, and also engages in exporting its products. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Arrowhead Seperation Engineering Limited
listings.about: Arrowhead Seperation Engineering Limited engages in the designing, manufacturing, erection, commissioning trading, and consultancy of chemical and process equipment in India. It offers rotary dryers, flaker systems, liquid discharge systems, single and double drum dryers, air impingement and particulate dryers, application rollers, paddle and belt dryers, calcination systems, and double cone vacuum dryers. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Artemis ADR Marketplace Limited
listings.about: Artemis ADR Marketplace Limited manufactures and trades in spices, masalas, food grains, and kirana products in India. The company also offers almonds, cashews, pistachios, jeera, black pepper, kaju katli, badam sticks, cookies, snacks, mouth fresheners, seeds and sweets, and other related products. It offers products through its showrooms, as well as through its website habiton.in. The company was formerly known as Jetmall Spices and Masala Limited and changed its name to Artemis ADR Marketplace Limited in May 2026. Jetmall Spices and Masala Limited founded in 1947 and is based in Chandigarh, India.

listings.name: ASARFI HOSPITAL LIMITED
listings.about: Asarfi Hospital Limited operates a hospital under the Asarfi Hospital name in India. The company offers primary health services, such as health camp and health education center, drug distribution, vaccination, health, and hygiene awareness program, as well as operates yoga and exercise center, health resort, and health information center. Asarfi Hospital Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Dhanbad, India.

listings.name: Associated Coaters Limited
listings.about: Associated Coaters Limited engages in the provision of pre-treatment and powder coating services for aluminum extrusions in architect and real estate industries in India. It also offers wood coating and polyvinylidene fluoride coating services on metals; and industrial fabrication services. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Kolkata, India.

listings.name: ASTONEA LABS LIMITED
listings.about: Astonea Labs Limited manufactures and markets pharmaceutical and cosmetic products under the Glow Up, Avicel, and Regero brand names in India and internationally. The company offers pharmaceutical products, including generics, OTC products, specialty therapeutics, nutraceuticals, and biosimilars, as well as cosmetic and personal care products, such as skincare, haircare, anti-aging, ethical, and organic cosmetic lines. It offers its products in tablets, capsules, softgels, soaps, oral and external powders, ointments, aerosols, creams, and lotions, as well as toothpastes and mouthwashes. Astonea Labs Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Panchkula, India.

listings.name: Astron Multigrain Limited
listings.about: Astron Multigrain Limited produces and sells instant noodles, papads, seasoning products, and noodle bhujia under the Astron's Swagy Noodles brand name in India. The company also engages in contract manufacturing services under private labeling. The company sells its products through super stockiest and wholesalers/distributors. Astron Multigrain Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Rajkot, Gujarat.

listings.name: Aten Papers & Foam Limited
listings.about: Aten Papers & Foam Limited engages in the paper trading business in India. It offers kraft paper, absorbent kraft paper, tube kraft paper, paper bag kraft paper, coating based paper, food grade paper, machine glazed paper, and pressure sensitive adhesive paper. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Atharva Poly-Plast Limited
listings.about: Atharva Poly-Plast Limited manufactures plastic moulded components for the furniture, home appliance, and automotive sectors. It serves businesses in North America, Europe, South America, the Middle East, Africa, and Southeast Asia. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Pune, India.

listings.name: Athena Constructions Limited
listings.about: Athena Constructions Limited constructs and develops real estate and infrastructure projects in India. The company also offers advisory services for construction, real estate, infrastructure, and other projects. Athena Constructions Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: APOLLO TECHNO INDUSTRIES LIMITED
listings.about: Apollo Techno Industries Limited engages in the engineering and manufacturing of trenchless technology and foundation equipment for the construction industry in India. The company manufactures horizontal directional drilling rigs, a trenchless technology for installation of essential utilities, such as gas pipelines, water supply lines, sewer lines, optical fibre cables, and electrical conduits; diaphragm wall drilling rigs used in constructing foundations for deep basements, retaining walls in railway, and airports and metro stations, as well as developments along riverfronts; and rotary drilling rigs for high-rise buildings, bridges, urban infrastructure, metro and rapid rail connectivity, flyovers, and general construction. The company also offers spare parts, which includes drill rods, hydraulic pumps, filters, oil seals, electric components, etc.; and warranties, on-site support, and technical training services. It exports in Nepal, the United Arab Emirates, the Middle East, and Russia. Apollo Techno Industries Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Mehsana, India.

listings.name: AUREATE TRADDE LIMITED
listings.about: Aureate Tradde Limited engages in the trading, distribution, and supply of industrial and technological materials. The company's product portfolio comprises polymers and petrochemicals, lithium-ion and sodium-ion cells, and electric vehicle chargers. It serves customers, including small, medium, and large enterprises. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: AUSTERE SYSTEMS LIMITED
listings.about: Austere Systems Limited operates as a software development, and information technology (IT) services and solutions company in India. The company's services and solutions include software development, software as a service, mobile application development, information technology solutions, database management, IT enabled services, training and development, web development, web and portal operations, e-commerce platforms, ERP and MIS solutions, data analytics and artificial intelligence services, process automation, and digital transformation, as well as data and document management storage. It also engages in the reselling of software products; and providing business process outsourcing and knowledge management solutions. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Pune, India.

listings.name: Avax Apparels and Ornaments Limited
listings.about: Avax Apparels and Ornaments Limited engages in the wholesale trading and manufacturing of knitted cloth in India. It operates through two segments, Wholesale Trading of Knitted Cloth and Online Retail of Silver Ornaments. The company offers cotton, crepe, denim, linen, satin, synthetic, and velvet fabrics, as well as flat or jersey knit and purl knit fabrics used in manufacturing of ladies and gents' jackets. It is involved in the online retail of silver ornaments and jewelry through blushines.com, an e-commerce portal. The company was formerly known as Avax Soft Technologies Limited and changed its name to Avax Apparels and Ornaments Limited in June 2023. Avax Apparels and Ornaments Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in New Delhi, India.

listings.name: Aztec Fluids & Machinery Limited
listings.about: Aztec Fluids & Machinery Limited manufactures and sells printers in India. The company offers continuous inkjet, thermal transfer overprint, drop on demand, and laser printers. It is also involved in trading of inks, as well as provides makeup and wash. In addition, the company offers turnkey solutions, such as vision inspection system, integrated software, hardware (printers), pneumatic rejection system, integration with packing line, web based & mobile based platform, print sample images, vision inspection system with rejection, serialization, system integrator with customize software, end-to-end traceability, aggregation, warehouse management, checkweigher, cloud based server, web/ mobile based application, digital factory. It serves for pharmaceuticals, FMCG and food processing, beverages, agrochemicals, automotive and engineering, construction materials, beauty & personal care, wires and cables industries. Aztec Fluids & Machinery Limited was founded in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: BAI-KAKAJI POLYMERS LIMITED
listings.about: Bai-Kakaji Polymers Limited manufactures and supplies packaging solutions for the beverage and food industry in India. The company produces bottle caps for packaged drinking water, carbonated beverages, juices, plastic jars, and dairy products. Its products include PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate) Preforms, injection-molded components for manufacturing plastic bottles and containers; PET Preform caps, plastic closures, including bottle caps and jars; and other flexible packaging solutions including LDPE Shrink Film, Stretch/Pallet Wrap Film, Surface Protection Film, Stretch hood Tubular Film, VCI Film, Cling Film, Silage Wrap, and Milk Film. In addition, it offers shrink and adhesive films. Bai-Kakaji Polymers Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Latur, India.

listings.name: Bhatia Colour Chem Limited
listings.about: Bhatia Colour Chem Limited engages in manufacturing and trading of chemicals, dyes, and auxiliary products in India. The company is involved in the manufacturing of plastic granules and value-added printing products, such as powder chemicals, glitter powders, and textile printing dyes and chemicals; production of plastic packaging solutions; and trading of stamping foils. It also offers specialized products, including foil binders and Zari binders; and textile auxiliaries for use in washing and dyeing of yarns and fabrics. Bhatia Colour Chem Limited was founded in 1975 and is based in Surat, India.

listings.name: B. D. Industries (Pune) Limited
listings.about: B. D. Industries (Pune) Limited develops, manufactures, supplies, and sells molded plastic products in India and internationally. It offers road safety products, such as barricades, bull nose, bollards, light barriers, traffic cones, spring posts, delineator posts, metal barricades, speed breakers, parking management products, road studs, safety batons, personal safety products, and other road safety products; material handling products, such as pallets, container and crates, battery formation jars, skips, insulated boxes, crate guards, pallet containers, and engine skids; automotive and off-road products, such as plastic fuel tank, expansion tank, adblue tank, hydraulic tank, consoles, fenders, seats, rooftop, barricade, transmission cover, and cup holders; waste management products, such as dustbins, garbage chute, containers, ghamelas, and wheel barrows; power and energy products, include solar hot water tank, street light poles, light globes, and battery boxes; healthcare products, include hospital beds, hospital closets, and stretcher; sanitation products, include portable toilets; marine products, such as cable buoys, floats, plastic fuel tanks, floating docks, marine barricaded, and custom molding products. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Beezaasan Explotech Limited
listings.about: Beezaasan Explotech Limited manufactures and supplies explosives and explosive accessories for cement, construction, mining, and defense industries in India. It offers cartridge explosives, including slurry explosives, emulsion explosives, detonating fuses, and cast boosters. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Himatnagar, India.

listings.name: Benara Bearings and Pistons Limited
listings.about: Benara Bearings & Pistons Limited engages in manufacturing and dealing with auto parts and engine parts for use in diesel and automobile engines in India. Its product portfolio includes pistons, piston pins, piston rings, engine bearings and bushes, air-cooled blocks, ball bearings, cam shafts, connecting rods, cylinder kits, cylinder liners and sleeves, engine valves, liner piston sets, spark plugs, rocker arms, timing chains, valve guides. The company also exports its products. Benara Bearings & Pistons Limited was founded in 1970 and is based in Agra, India.

listings.name: Benchmark Computer Solutions Limited
listings.about: Benchmark Computer Solutions Limited operates as an information technology (IT) infrastructure solutions and technology consulting company in India. It operates through four segments: IT Infrastructure Solutions; Software and Web based Application Development Services; Application Management Services; and Leasing of Services. The company offers IT equipment sales and rental, IT networking, datacentre, IT security and data backup and recovery solutions. It also provides requirement detailing and analysis; UI prototype and system architecture; application design and development, system testing; provide user acceptance testing platform; and final handover. In addition, the company provides Technical experts Online or offline; Routine check-up of the system; preventive maintenance of the computers, printers, and other accessories; and Attending to any breakdown and emergencies. Benchmark Computer Solutions Limited was founded in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Bhanderi Infracon Limited
listings.about: Bhanderi Infracon Limited engages in the real estate development business and related incidental services in India. The company develops and constructs residential buildings. It also constructs commercial offices, and shops, as well as factories, sheds, and workshops. The company was formerly known as Bileshwar Industrial Estate Developers Private Limited and changed its name to Bhanderi Infracon Limited in February 2013. Bhanderi Infracon Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: BHARATROHAN AIRBORNE INNOVATIONS LIMITED
listings.about: BharatRohan Airborne Innovations Limited, an agritech company, provides agri value chain solutions to agriculture farms, food companies, traders, consumers, and farmers. It offers crop monitoring services via drones, such as integrated crop management practices and sale of agri-output products. The company also provides data processing services. It collects data from agricultural farms and converts it into reports for industrial producers. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Gurugram, India.

listings.name: BHAVIK ENTERPRISES LIMITED
listings.about: Bhavik Enterprises Limited engages in trading of polymers in India. It primarily offers linear low-density, low-density, high-density, and metallocene linear low-density polyethylene and polypropylene; and homo polymer, impact co-polymer and random co-polymer polypropylene products for applications in various industries, such as packaging, infrastructure, agriculture, and others. It serves manufacturers of pressure pipes, non-pressure pipes, drip pipe, shrink film, lamination film, mulch film, greenhouse films, CPP films, liners, EPE foam, woven sack bags, spun bond nonwoven fabric, paint pails, crates, houseware products, suitcases, and thin wall containers. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Billwin Industries Limited
listings.about: Billwin Industries Limited manufactures, trades, and exports protective gears which are manufactured by using coated fabric as the raw material in India. The company also offers rain jacket with hood and leggings/slicker suits, and raincoats for men, women, and children; pulsar jacket, winter jacket, river raft boat, inflatable boats dinghys, sleeping bags, school bags, life jackets, rucksack, facial's mask; flame-resistant and anti-static garments, safety uniforms, marine gear; and luggage, office, travel, school, and laptop bags. Billwin Industries Limited was founded in 2006 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Bindal Exports Limited
listings.about: Bindal Exports Limited manufactures and exports textiles, garments, and made ups in India under the Fashfun brand. It offers various blends of fabrics, including polyester, rayon, cotton, satin, chiffon, knitted, viscose, georgette, brasso, lycra, crepe, burnout, textured dyed, voiles, bottom weight, digital print, etc. that are used for manufacturing of garments in the apparel industry, as well as bathing and furnishing industries, etc. The company also trades in grey cloth and fabrics. In addition, it undertakes value additional work of fabrics comprising embroidery work, Tikli work, glitter work, etc. The company exports its products in Germany, Nigeria, France, Spain, the United Kingdom, Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Mauritius, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Yemen, Kuwait, Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia. Bindal Exports Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Surat, India.

listings.name: Bizotic Commercial Limited
listings.about: Bizotic Commercial Limited engages in the designing, manufacturing, marketing, and retailing of readymade garments under the URBAN UNITED and YARD brand in India. It is involved in wholesale of fabrics and branded retail services; and supplies uniforms and corporate suits to corporate clients, as well as electronics products. The company sells its products through menswear outlets. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: BLT Logistics Limited
listings.about: BLT Logistics Limited engages in the logistics and warehousing sector in India. It provides surface transportation of goods in containerized trucks and warehousing services to various industries and businesses. The company also offers transportation and allied services as a B2B service provider to a diverse mix of clients engaged in business of electronics, retail, food and confectionery, wholesale traders, and other MNCs; packing and moving services; and project cargo transportation services. As of March 31, 2025, it owned operational fleet of 106 vehicles. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in New Delhi, India.

listings.name: Bothra Metals & Alloys Limited
listings.about: Bothra Metals and Alloys Limited manufactures and sells non-ferrous metal products in India. The company offers aluminum profiles comprising window, solar, roller shutter, pipes, partition, motor body, modular kitchen, curtain wall, LED, ladder, AC grill, industrial, greenhouse, heat sink, customized, curtain rail, formwork, facade, architectural, and ferrules profiles; aluminum extrusions, sheets, billets, and ingots; ferrous and non-ferrous scraps; and other non-ferrous metals, including copper, brass, and zinc. It also engages in the import and trading of aluminum and other metal scraps. The company serves the logistics, automobile, solar, facade, construction site, aviation, shipping, military, railway, consumer appliance, space satellite, robotics, modular furniture, power line, and other industries. Bothra Metals and Alloys Limited was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Bondada Engineering Limited
listings.about: Bondada Engineering Limited provides engineering, procurement, construction, and operations and maintenance services for telecom and solar sectors in India. It also engages in design, procurement, construction, and commissioning of solar project; planning, upgradation, construction, and installation of telecommunications infrastructure, such as monopoles, guyed towers, and lattice towers; railway infrastructure; and data centers maintenance. In addition, the company provides Autoclaved Aerated Concrete blocks under the SmartBrix brand name; uPVC window and door systems under the truVU brand; and aluminium windows and doors under AluRise brand name. Further, it offers tower pole supplies, LED lights, and EV and drone motors; and manufactures and supplies telecom, and transmission and distribution towers. Bondada Engineering Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

listings.name: B.R.GOYAL INFRASTRUCTURE LIMITED
listings.about: B.R.Goyal Infrastructure Limited, an infrastructure development company, engages in the execution of engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) projects in India. The company is involved in EPC contracts, such as roads and highways, bridges and building infra, and waste water infrastructure; residential/industrial plotting projects; constructs and operates toll collection; and undertakes the construction, widening, rehabilitation, and maintenance of national highways, state highways, urban roads, bridges, and associated infrastructure. It also manufactures and supplies ready-mix concrete grades and specialized concrete solutions; and executes residential, commercial, institutional, industrial, educational, and public infrastructure projects. In addition, the company provides infrastructure solutions for government departments, public sector undertakings, statutory authorities, and private sector clients; design coordination, civil and structural works, mechanical, electrical and plumbing installations, finishing works, and comprehensive project execution. Further, it engages in wind power generation; real estate; and sale of goods. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Indore, India.

listings.name: Bright Outdoor Media Limited
listings.about: Bright Outdoor Media Limited provides out of home advertisement services in India. It offers advertising media services, including an array of service hoardings, such as railway boards, railway panels, transfer stickers, cinema slides, promos, full train, bus panels, full bus painting, mobile sign truck, kiosks, traffic booth, toll Naka, gantry, and vinyl. The company also provides various communication solutions to clients; and services assuring multicultural and ethnic outdoor advertising campaigns. In addition, it engages in the real estate business, which includes sale and purchase of properties and sharing the same on rental/leave and license basis. The company was formerly known as Bright Outdoor Media Private Limited and changed its name to Bright Outdoor Media Limited in November 2022. Bright Outdoor Media Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Brisk Technovision Limited
listings.about: Brisk Technovision Limited engages in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity services in India. The company offers managed services, including security management, asset management, email management, data center and recovery, and network management, as well as facility management; system integration solutions, such as annual maintenance contracts, IT audit services, and infrastructure setup and management. It also provides technology services, comprising infra health check services, incident response services, and disaster recovery as a service (DRaaS). In addition, the company offers professional services, which include data center virtualization, cloud consulting, data and network security, and digital workspace solutions. Further, it provides email and network security solutions. Brisk Technovision Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Thane, India.

listings.name: BROACH LIFECARE HOSPITAL LIMITED
listings.about: Broach Lifecare Hospital Limited engages in the business of hospital and healthcare services in India. It provides general medical care, indoor care, intensive care, and critical care and ventilator support facilities, as well as medications and pharmaceutical, day care, electrocardiogram, 2D-echo, treadmill test, Holter monitor, lab treatment, and X-ray services. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Bharuch, India.

listings.name: B-RIGHT REALESTATE LIMITED
listings.about: B-Right Realestate Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development and investment activities in India. It is involved in the construction and development of residential and commercial projects; and provision of finance and leasing services. The company was formerly known as Marshal Vinimay Limited and changed its name to B-Right Realestate Limited in September 2020. B-Right Realestate Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Cargosol Logistics Limited
listings.about: Cargosol Logistics Limited provides logistics services in India and internationally. The company offers NVOCC; sea and air freight forwarding; surface transportation; warehousing and distribution; multimodal transportation; projects and break bulk; customs clearance; hazardous cargo; and vessel chartering services. It also provides other value-added services, including door to door delivery, cargo insurance, and palletization. The company serves the power, consumer good, automobile, FMCG, defense and government, chemicals, infrastructure, technology, pharmaceuticals, and industrial industries. Cargosol Logistics Limited was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Cargotrans Maritime Limited
listings.about: Cargotrans Maritime Limited provides ocean freight forwarding and transportation services in India. The company offers ocean freight forwarding (both full container load and less than container load); transportation; customs clearance; warehousing; and other value-added logistics solutions. It also provides bulk cargo handling, shipment-related certifications, and insurance services. Cargotrans Maritime Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Gandhidham, India.

listings.name: Chandra Bhagat Pharma Limited
listings.about: Chandra Bhagat Pharma Limited engages in the marketing of pharmaceutical critical care and health care products in India and internationally. It offers pharmaceutical formulations, including intravenous and intramuscular injections, tablets, and capsules in various therapeutic categories, such as anti-cancer, antibiotics, anesthesia, hormones, orthopedic, cardiac, cardiovascular, anti-fungal, antiviral, pediatrics, cardiology, nephrology, and neurology to Hospitals and Health care Centers through distribution networks and sales force under its own brand. The company also promotes and markets specialty chemicals, as well as intermediates and active pharmaceuticals ingredients. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: CITY CROPS AGRO LIMITED
listings.about: City Crops Agro Limited engages in the production and sale of agricultural products in India. It also trades in agricultural products. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: CFF FLUID CONTROL LIMITED
listings.about: CFF Fluid Control Limited manufactures, overhauls, repairs, and maintains shipboard machinery, combat systems, reference, and test facilities for submarines and surface ships for Indian navy. The company offers defence solutions for ships and submarines, including indigenization, manufacturing, integration, installation and commissioning of systems and through life cycle support for various ships and submarines and unmanned platforms; rapid prototyping and exotic material precision fabrication for land and air platforms from turbo charger assemblies for tanks to wings and fins of next generation missiles; and support services comprising complex structural repairs, overhaul of mechanical, electrical, communication, navigation systems, and provision of lifecycle support. It is also involved in the manufacture of critical components, assemblies, sub-assemblies, equipment, and systems; and strategic projects which includes rapid prototyping, concept to commissioning equipment, and integrating systems for manned and unmanned platforms. In addition, the company provides specialized solutions for energy, including manufacturing and installation of fuel handling transport and storage to water and toxic gas monitoring systems, such as steam and water analyzer and wet rack systems; and installs and commissions on- board, mobile, and land based clean energy applications, as well as engages in retrofitting new builds in the clean energy propulsion arena for locomotive and marine based assets; and manufacturing and integration services for energy sector. CFF Fluid Control Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: CHATHA FOODS LIMITED
listings.about: Chatha Foods Limited engages in the manufacture and retail of frozen and ready-to-eat processed meat products in India. The company offers non-vegetarian, vegetarian, and plant-based products. It also provides snacks and accompaniments; patties; sausages; cold cuts; toppings and fillers; and chicken keema and smoked chicken breast. It serves quick-serving and casual dining restaurants, and various hotel-restaurant-catering segments under the Tempter and TheFieldGrill brand names. Chatha Foods Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Mohali, India.

listings.name: Cian Healthcare Limited
listings.about: Cian Healthcare Limited engages in the research, development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of pharmaceutical products in India. It offers pharmaceutical products in various therapeutic areas of gynecology, haematinic, cardio- diabetic, orthopedic, pediatric, dermacosmetic, antibiotic, CNS, and vitamins and nutrient products. The company also provides male and female infertility, reproductive wellness, energy boosting, autism, multivitamins, joint care products, and haematinic products, as well as face and hair serums, veterinary products, and cosmetics. It offers its products in the form of tablets, capsules, soft gels, liquid orals, ointments/ creams and sachets, and cosmetics. The company exports its products to various countries, such as Afghanistan, Benin, Bhutan, Bolivia, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Pune, India.

listings.name: Chemkart India Limited
listings.about: Chemkart India Limited engages in the trading of various food and health ingredients in India. It offers amino acids, health supplements, herbal extracts, nucleotides, proteins, and vitamins, as well as sports nutrition products. The company also provides nutritional supplements and components, such as glycine, creatine monohydrate 200mesh, inositol, L-arginine, L-glutamine, L-carmitne, N-acetyl L-cysteine, taurine, L-glutathione, and whey protein concentrate. In addition, it engages in the trading and processing of nutraceutical products. The company also exports its products to Germany, Nepal, New Zealand, Portugal, Saudi Arabia, Slovakia, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Switzerland, Turkey, and the United Arab Emirates. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Chiraharit Limited
listings.about: Chiraharit Limited an integrated infrastructure company engages in providing turnkey engineering, procurement and construction solutions in India. The company is also involved in the design, supplement, installation, testing, and commissioning of advanced irrigation systems including drip, sprinkler, and rain gun technologies for agricultural and landscape needs. Its solutions include module cleaning systems, EPC for piped irrigation network, center pivot irrigation systems, HDPE pipe and fittings, rain gun and drip irrigation systems, hose reel irrigator, and landscape irrigation solutions. In addition, the company delivers sustainable solutions for potable water supply, grey water treatment and reuse, and bulk industrial water transfer in water management and renewable energy sectors. Chiraharit Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

listings.name: CHOTHANI FOODS LIMITED
listings.about: Chothani Foods Limited manufactures and trades in masala and spices in India. The company offers blended spices, including chole masala, white peppers, dry mango powders, black pepper powders, chaat masala, and garam masala; grounded spices, such as turmeric, cumin, ginger, coriander, red chili, and green chili powders; and vegetable powder comprising garlic powder, as well as whole and grinded spices. It also provides pav bhaji, tea, sambhar, punjabi chole, biryani/pulav, and kitchen king masala products; and jeera and white pepper powders. The company exports its products. It sells its products under the APPU MASALA and GAYATRI MASALA brands. The company was formerly known as Ashok Masala Mart Limited and changed its name to Chothani Foods Limited in March 2018. Chothani Foods Limited was founded in 1975 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Chatterbox Technologies Limited
listings.about: Chatterbox Technologies Limited engages in the provision of digital and influencer marketing, and social media management services in India and the Middle East. It operates in two segments, Chtrbox and Chtrsocial. The Chtrbox segment operates as an influencer and marketing platform and agency that connects brands/products and social media influencers. Its ChtrSocial segment provides social media management and brand design services. The company's solutions also include Chtr Studios, which includes conceptualizing, scripting, pre-production planning, shooting, editing, optimizing and distribution of content with influencers; Bharatbox, which creates content with regional influencers; Chtrbox Represent, a creator talent management division that represents, manages, and supports creators and influencers' digital assets; Youth-Ink, a youth marketing solution that works with college ambassadors and create campus programs to build user-generated content; and Chtr International, which operates an international influencer marketing company. The company was formerly known as Chatterbox Technologies Private Limited and changed its name to Chatterbox Technologies Limited in October 2024. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Mumbai, India. Chatterbox Technologies Limited operates as a subsidiary of QYOU Media Inc.

listings.name: Citichem India Limited
listings.about: Citichem India Limited imports and trades in chemicals in India. It also provides aluminum chloride anhydrous, hydrochloric acid, liquid chlorine, PVC resin suspension, carbon black, phenol, acetone, chloroform, pyrolysis oil, thiourea, phenol crystal, acetic acid, sulphur, mono sodium glutamate, ascorbic acid, phosphoric acid food, refined glycerin, potassium carbonate, and paraffin wax. In addition, the company manufacturers organic, inorganic, specialty, and food chemicals. Citichem India Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: JAY AMBE SUPERMARKETS LIMITED
listings.about: Jay Ambe Supermarkets Limited engages in the retail supermarkets trading activities in India. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.

listings.name: CLARA INDUSTRIES LIMITED
listings.about: Clara Industries Limited manufactures and sells low and high-density polyethylene and polypropylene products, biaxially oriented polypropylene products, adhesive tapes, and related products in India. The company offers plastic bags, industrial packaging self-adhesive tapes, printing and plain multi layered flexible packaging products, pp plastic mats, and twines and ropes. It also provides flexible packaging products, packaging film, and horticulture bags. The company was formerly known as Chand Plastic Corporation. Clara Industries Limited was founded in 2008 and is based in Saharanpur, India.

listings.name: CLN ENERGY LIMITED
listings.about: CLN Energy Limited provides battery energy storage solutions in India. It offers lithium batteries for two-, three-, and four-wheeler electric vehicle; material handling equipment; electric tractors; and golf carts, as well as customized solutions. The company also provides lithium-ion solar batteries, residential and industrial battery energy storage systems, grid application battery energy storage solutions, and lithium-ion batteries for telecom applications. In addition, it offers hub motors and controllers; mid mount motors and controllers; and electric vehicle components comprising wiring harnesses, IoT, and DC-DC converters. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Dadri, India. CLN Energy Limited operates as a subsidiary of CLN Energy Pte., LTD.

listings.name: Concord Control Systems Limited
listings.about: Concord Control Systems Limited manufactures and sells electrical and electronics products for Indian Railways in India. The company offers inter-vehicular couplers, emergency lighting systems, brushless DC carriage fans, exhaust fans, cable jackets, bellows, battery chargers, control and distribution panels, and tensile load testing machines. It also provides train vehicle control units, train driver display, distributed power wireless control systems, and remote monitoring rail systems. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Lucknow, India.

listings.name: CAPITALNUMBERS INFOTECH  LIMITED
listings.about: CapitalNumbers Infotech Limited provides digital consulting, information technology engineering, and software development solutions to enterprises and startups in India, the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. The company offers digital engineering services, such as custom web and mobile app development, api development and integration, platform modernization and reengineering, product engineering and MVP development, and maintenance and support; data analytics and engineering; artificial intelligence (AI), generative AI, and machine learning; cloud engineering; e-commerce development and staff augmentation services; salesforce development; quality assurance; and user-interface and user experience design services, as well as blockchain and augmented reality and virtual reality services. It serves healthcare, banking and financial services, real estate, automotive, entertainment, energy, sports, manufacturing sectors, logistics, retail, travel, education, and agriculture industries. CapitalNumbers Infotech Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

listings.name: Command Polymers Limited
listings.about: Command Polymers Limited manufactures and markets polymer products in India. Its products primarily include polythene LF tubes, tarpoulin sheets, and polyester fabrics. The company also manufactures, produces, buys, sells, exchanges, works, alters, improves, imports, exports, and deals in various types of plastic goods, boots, shoes, clogs, and footwears; leather footwear; rubber, leather, boots, trees, laces, buckles, and leggings; and boot polishes, purses, bags, boxes, belts, and accessories and fittings. Command Polymers Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in South 24 Parganas, India.

listings.name: Comrade Appliances Limited
listings.about: Comrade Appliances Limited manufactures and supplies home appliances, electrical machinery, and apparatus in India. The company offers air coolers, electric geysers, induction cooktops, and washing machines. It also provides plastic molding, metal pressing, assembling and packaging, and product design services. In addition, the company offers plastic moulded components for the consumer durable and electronics, household, pharma, automobile, and toy industries; and geyser parts, SS tank assembly plates, and cone/inner of fire extinguisher and stainless-steel items. Comrade Appliances Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: CONTAINE TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED
listings.about: Containe Technologies Limited engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and service of vehicle speed limiting devices and vehicle location tracking devices in India. The company offers speed limiting devices, a safety product for new registration, as well as commercial vehicles of goods carriers, hazardous petroleum and chemical tankers, public transport, and school buses under MotorEye and Limits brand. It also provides data transmission of vehicle health parameters, driver behavior analytics, and engine diagnostics; location tracking using both GNSS and the NavIC for accuracy and reliability; data communication to ensure the integrity and privacy of fleet data; and over-the-air firmware update capabilities. In addition, the company is involved in the embedded SIM cards and M2M services businesses. Containe Technologies Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

listings.name: Cosmic CRF Limited
listings.about: Cosmic CRF Limited manufactures and supplies cold rolled stainless sections and other engineering products in India. The company offers fabricated items for railway coaches and wagons, cold rolled formed items for wagons and coaches, cold rolled formed items for infra companies and EPC projects, and products for roadways and national highways. It also offers coated coil, tubes, rebars, and wire rods. Cosmic CRF Limited serves the wagon carts, electrical transmission, defense, and real estate sectors. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

listings.name: Cospower Engineering Limited
listings.about: Cospower Engineering Limited manufactures and supplies re-active power compensation systems, harmonic filters, and other engineering goods in India and internationally. It offers high-tension and low-tension capacitors, electrical panels, and substation structures. The company also provides PF improvement products, including real-time power factor correction, automatic power factor control panel, HV, and CosVar manager panel; power control center panels; MCC panel; vacuum circuit breaker switch board; control and relay panel; and reactive power compensation services; and electrical turnkey contacts, including substation construction, electrical panels supply, and other electrical equipment. In addition, it is involved in the supply, erection, testing, and commissioning of substation equipment, capacitor banks, and electrical panels. The company serves various industries, such as steel, cement, textile, ferro alloys, foundries, chemical and fertilizer, oil and gas, paper, sugar, glass, infrastructure, OEMs, EPCs, hospitality and commercial establishment, etc. Cospower Engineering Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: United Cotfab Limited
listings.about: United Cotfab Limited engages in the manufacturing of open-end yarn for the textile industry. It offers cotton open-end yarn for use in the production of textiles, sewing, crocheting, knitting, weaving, embroidery, and rope making. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: CITY PULSE MULTIVENTURES LIMITED
listings.about: City Pulse Multiventures Limited is a cultural complex, which provides a collection of cinema formats through WOW Cine pulse technology. City Pulse Multiventures Limited was formerly known as City Pulse Multiplex Limited and change its name to City Pulse Multiventures Limited in November 2024. City Pulse Multiventures Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: CRAZY SNACKS LIMITED
listings.about: Crazy Snacks Limited manufactures and sells bakery and snack products. It offers bread, buns, cookies, cup cake, layer cake, slice cake, rusks, namkeen, snacks under the Crazy, Bity, and Baked Gold brand names. It sells its products through dealers and retail stores. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Gorakhpur, India.

listings.name: CRYOGENIC OGS LIMITED
listings.about: Cryogenic OGS Limited designs, manufactures, and sells filtration, metering, and separation systems in India. It offers prover tank, bulk air eliminator, strainer cum air eliminator, truck loading/wagon loading skid with ethanol/bio diesel blending with additive injection, natural gas metering, pressure reduction skid, LNG truck loading skid, crude oil metering skid, LPG blending skid, additive injection skid, additive Injection block/panel with PLC, blue dye and marker skid, basket strainer, turbine upstream and downstream meter run, turbine flow straightener, volume bottle, and LPG vapour eliminator. The company serves oil and gas, petrochemicals, chemicals, and liquor industries. It exports its products to Singapore, Nigeria, Mauritius, and Kenya. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Vadodara, India.

listings.name: Captain Technocast Limited
listings.about: Captain Technocast Limited manufactures and sells investment casting products in India. The company offers casting products, including industrial valve, industrial pump, firefighting equipment, structure and hardware, automobile, engineering and automation, power plant boiler parts, building and water treatment parts, piping and clamping parts, and lost wax, as well as feinguss and micro fusion. It sells its products in various steel forms, such carbon, alloy, super alloy, non-ferrous, stainless, and super duplex. The company exports its products in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Italy, Germany, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, Mexico, Australia, and the Asia-Pacific region. Captain Technocast Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Rajkot, India.

listings.name: Clinitech Laboratory Limited
listings.about: Clinitech Laboratory Limited engages in the healthcare business in India. The company provides services including pathology testing laboratories, diagnostic centers, scan centers, X-ray and ECG clinics, and other services. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Dachepalli Publishers Limited
listings.about: Dachepalli Publishers Limited, content-based educational publishing house that publishes K-12 segment textbooks for CBSE, ICSE, and State Board curriculums. It also provides schools with curriculum-aligned digital resources. It distributes its books under Apple Book Company, Orange Leaf Publishers, Pelican Publishing House, Sangam Publishing House, and School Book Company brands. It distributes its products through distributors and dealers. Dachepalli Publishers Limited was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

listings.name: DAPS ADVERTISING LIMITED
listings.about: DAPS Advertising Limited, an advertising agency, provides display, creative, recruitment, and tender ads in India. It provides newspaper advertising, outdoor media advertising, digital media advertising through social media platforms, seminars, event management, and road shows. The company serves construction, education, electronics, automobiles, FMCG, jewellery, clothing and apparels, insurance, housing, hospital, trading-stock and public issues, and aviation industries, as well as government organizations. DAPS Advertising Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Kanpur, India.

listings.name: Davin Sons Retail Limited
listings.about: Davin Sons Retail Limited designs and manufactures readymade garments in India. It offers jeans, denim fabrics and jackets, t-shirts, and shirts. The company also distributes packaged products, such as biscuits, chips, oil, non-alcoholic energy drinks, toffy, chocolates, etc. to various retailers, shopkeepers, and other distributors and agents. Davin Sons Retail Limited was founded in 2012 and is based in Delhi, India.

listings.name: DEEPAK CHEMTEX LIMITED
listings.about: Deepak Chemtex Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of colorants in India. It offers acid blue 9 powder and liquid, fast green FCF, acid dyes, salt-free and pond dyes, lake colors, and dye intermediates, as well as food, drug, and cosmetic colors. The company's products are used in various applications, including confectionary, bakery, desserts, beverages, dairy products, seasonings, pet food, pharmaceutical products, cosmetics, personal care and car wash products, portable sanitation cleaners, detergent and soap, fuel, oil and lubricants, smoke, seed treatment, crop protection, fertilizer indicators, and floral dyes, as well as ink jet inks applications. It also exports its products in China, France, Kenya, Mexico, Europe, Japan, Australia, the United Kingdom, the United States of America, and other countries. Deepak Chemtex Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Chennai, India.

listings.name: Defrail Technologies Limited
listings.about: Defrail Technologies Limited manufactures and sells rubber parts and components for use in automotive, railways, and defense industries. It offers rubber hoses and assemblies, such as air brake hose assemblies feed and break pipes, hydraulic hoses, radiator hoses, long-length hoses, silicone hoses, silicon tubes, branch hoses, co-extruded hoses, diesel and petroleum hose pipes, nylon tubes, and LPG hose pipes. The company also provides rubber profiles and beadings, including aluminum window rubber beadings, EPDM rubber profiles, automotive windshield rubber profiles, rubber sponges, glass rubber seal beadings, metal insert rubber, silicon rubber profiles, and railway beadings; and rubber molded parts comprising bellows, seals, bushes, gaskets, air intake houses, anti-drain back valves, customized rubber, dust covers, hose holders, silicon o rings, grommets, elastomeric pads, and vestibules. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Faridabad, India.

listings.name: Desco Infratech Limited
listings.about: Desco Infratech Limited operates as an infrastructure company in India. The company undertakes city gas distribution network project works, such as piped natural gas, commercial and industrial natural gas connection, operation and maintenance of steel, medium-density polyethylene (MDPE) and GI network, MDPE pipeline laying, lock pressure test and leak detection test, manpower supply for protection of assets, and carbon steel pipeline laying and commissioning; and power distribution project works, including precise installation, erection, and commissioning of low and high tension cables for power distribution. It also undertakes water distribution projects and other associated works, which include designing and building water distribution networks, such as open well, sump well, overhead tanks, high-density polyethylene and ductile iron pipelines, and water receiving chambers, as well as offers foundational support in renewable energy projects comprising erection of RCC piles, erection of structure and solar modules, and commissioning of solar modules. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Surat, India.

listings.name: Dev Labtech Venture Limited
listings.about: Dev Labtech Venture Limited manufactures, wholesales, and trades in polished and lab grown diamonds in India. The company offers natural diamonds for use in jewelry and industrial cutting tools; and lab grown diamonds for use in jewelry, as well as machining and cutting tools, thermal conductor, optical material, electronics, semi-conductors, electronic industries, etc.; chemical vapor deposition diamonds; and trading of pearls and precious Stones. It also provides its products through its online platform. In addition, the company exports its products to the United States of America, the United Arab Emirates, and Europe. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Bhavnagar, India.

listings.name: DEVSON CATALYST LIMITED
listings.about: Devson Catalyst Limited manufactures and sells catalysts, adsorbents, and ceramic bed supports in global markets. The company offers products, such as chloride guards, catalyst carriers, molecular sieves, claus catalysts, sulphur guards, ceramic and alumina balls, ceramic tower packing, hydrotreating catalysts, reforming catalysts, and activated alumina. It serves the oil and gas, refining, petrochemicals, steel, fertilizers, chemicals, and environmental sectors. Devson Catalyst Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Surendranagar, India.

listings.name: DINDIGUL FARM PRODUCT LIMITED
listings.about: Dindigul Farm Product Limited engages in processing of milk and production of milk products in India. The company offers skimmed milk powder, milk protein concentrates, milk whey powder, whey powder, whey protein concentrate, evaporated milk, whole milk powder, dairy whitener, and casein. It also offers milk protein powder, infant milk powder, instant coffee dairy whitener, and women protein powder, customized solutions, as well as provides dairytex, icetex, and baketex. In addition, the company serves nutrition, dairy, ice cream, and baking industries. Dindigul Farm Product Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Dindigul, India.

listings.name: Diksha Greens Limited
listings.about: Diksha Greens Limited engages in the trading and distribution of various commodities and materials in India. The company supplies its products to retailers. Diksha Greens Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kolkata, India.

listings.name: DHARNI CAPITAL SERVICES LIMITED
listings.about: Dharni Capital Services Limited provides diversified financial services in India. The company offers mutual fund distribution, fixed deposit distribution, real estate brokerage, technical consultancy, and outsourcing services, as well as technology enabled investment and financial services platform with end-to-end solutions for financial product distribution in online and offline channels. It also provides bespoke advisory services comprising financial restructuring, fund raising, succession planning, and estate planning; and management consulting services. Dharni Capital Services Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

listings.name: Dhaval Packaging Limited
listings.about: Dhaval Packaging Limited designs, manufactures and sells In-Mold Labelling (IML) plastic containers and SAW pipe protection plastic caps in India. The company offers products, such as hexagon lock type containers, rectangle containers, khajur boxes, lunch boxes, square containers, sweet boxes, round containers, lassi glasses, and saw pipe protection plastic caps. It also offers end caps, such as Recessed caps, Large-size caps, PE plugs, and Customized caps. It serves to FMCG industry in domestic and international markets. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Dhillon Freight Carrier Limited
listings.about: Dhillon Freight Carrier Limited operates as a transport agency. The company provides logistics solutions in India. It offers parcel/less than truck-load, contract logistics, and fleet rental/fleet leasing services, as well as express parcel, full truck, warehousing services. The company serves to B2B and B2C customers. Dhillon Freight Carrier Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

listings.name: DHYAANI TRADEVENTTURES LIMITED
listings.about: Dhyaani Tradeventtures Limited engages in trading of agro products. The company deals in variety of agri-inputs and commodities. The company was formerly known as Dhyaani Tile And Marblez Limited and changed its name to Dhyaani Tradeventtures Limited in February 2024. Dhyaani Tradeventtures Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: DIGILOGIC SYSTEMS LIMITED
listings.about: Digilogic Systems Limited designs, develops, integrates, manufactures, supplies, and supports automated test equipment systems, radar and electronic warfare environmental simulators, application software, and embedded signal processing solutions for defence and aerospace engineering sector. It operates in three segments: Test Systems, Application Software, and Services. The company provides automated test systems and test jigs used during product development, manufacturing, and repairs; checkout systems, which are automated setups used to validate subsystems in aircraft, missiles, and industrial automation setups; and radar and electronic warfare simulators that recreate real-world threat scenarios, such as enemy radar or signal jamming for testing defence equipment. It also offers data acquisition system software to collect, monitor, and record physical signals, including temperature, voltage, or pressure from sensors in laboratories, factories, and defence setups; and intellectual property (IP) cores, which are reusable software blocks to help electronic systems process data. In addition, the company provides system integration, test and simulation design, firmware and software development, IP core development, consulting and engineering, upgradation and retrofit, training and documentation, and lifecycle support and maintenance services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Rangareddy, India.

listings.name: Diksat Transworld Limited
listings.about: Diksat Transworld Limited engages in the media and entertainment business in India. It owns and operates WIN TV, a Tamil news and current affairs channel; ASSERVATHAM TV, a Tamil devotional and religious channel; WIN TV UP, a 24/7 Hindi news and current affairs channel; and CUISINE TV, a 24/7 news and current affairs channel. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Chennai, India.

listings.name: DIKSHA POLYMERS LIMITED
listings.about: Diksha Polymers Limited manufactures and sells polyethylene terephthalate (PET) bottles/containers, preforms, jars, and caps. Its products are used for storage of beverages, oils, and other ancillary products in various industries, including lubricants, food and beverages, consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, etc. The company was incorporated 1998 and is based in Gwalior, India.

listings.name: Dolphin Kitchen Utencils and Appliances Limited
listings.about: Dolphin Kitchen Utencils and Appliances Limited engages in trading and marketing of stainless-steel products in India. It trades in S.S. patta, S.S. sheet, S.S. coil, S.S. scrap, S.S. pipe, and mild steel round and beam. The company also provides a range of kitchenware, including dinner sets, S.S. casseroles, S.S. multi kadai, S.S. water bottles, stainless steel sheets and circles, and various utensils under the DOLPHIN brand. In addition, it offers stainless steel bars, scrap, angle trim, and plates. The company was formerly known as Sai Swami Metals and Alloys Limited and changed its name to Dolphin Kitchen Utencils and Appliances Limited in September 2025. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: DR LALCHANDANI LABS LIMITED
listings.about: Dr Lalchandani Labs Limited provides diagnostic and related healthcare tests and services in India. The company offers doctor consultation, pathology, radiology, hospital lab management, corporate health checkup, and blood bank services, as well as X-ray, TMT, ultrasound, 2D-echo, and medical fitness examinations. It also offers its products online. The company serves individual patients, hospitals and other healthcare providers, and corporate customers. Dr Lalchandani Labs Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in New Delhi, India.

listings.name: Diggi Multitrade Limited
listings.about: Diggi Multitrade Limited engages in the trading of real estate properties in India. The company acquires and trades in land, flats, and commercial offices. It also trades in construction materials and fabrics. In addition, the company trades and distributes food products, fruits, vegetables, agro, sea, health, and protein foods, fast foods, packed foods, and others, as well as involved in agency, dealer, and franchisee related business. Diggi Multitrade Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Bhiwandi, India.

listings.name: DMR ENGINEERING LIMITED
listings.about: DMR Engineering Limited operates as an engineering consulting company in India, Lao PDR, Bhutan, Nepal, Cambodia, Uganda, Tanzania, Nigeria, and internationally. The company provides design and engineering, bid engineering, construction engineering, due diligence and advisory, and quality and inspection services. It serves hydropower, pumped storage, water resources, dams, barrages, roads, and rail tunnels. The company was formerly known as DMR Hydroengineering & Infrastructures Limited and changed its name to DMR Engineering Limited in August 2025. DMR Engineering Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Faridabad, India.

listings.name: DIPNA PHARMACHEM LIMITED
listings.about: Dipna Pharmachem Limited imports, trades in, and exports pharmaceutical products primarily in India. It offers industrial chemicals, pharmaceutical raw materials, excipients, solvents, active pharmaceutical ingredients, formulations, and intermediates. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: DRA CONSULTANTS LIMITED
listings.about: DRA Consultants Limited provides engineering consultancy services for urban and rural development, and industrial utility sectors in India. The company's services include public partnership, transaction advisory, bid process management, leak detection and NRW study, project management consultancy, survey, feasibility study, master plan report, detailed project report, water and energy audit, and industrial utility audits; and GIS, MIS, and centralized monitoring systems. It is also involved in the investment planning, procurement, bid preparation, bid process management, execution planning, quality assurance plan, cost control, project schedules, commissioning, trial runs, and performance monitoring; and provision of technical, commercial, legal, and financial advisory services for water supply, wastewater treatment, and water monitoring services. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Nagpur, India.

listings.name: Droneacharya Aerial Innovations Limited
listings.about: DroneAcharya Aerial Innovations Limited provides drone training services in India. The company offers drone survey and mapping, drone surveillance and videography, precision spraying, hardware, software and firmware, drone delivery, and underwater inspection services; and terrestrial mapping, strategic planning, and bathymetric solutions. It provides training services, including drone pilot training; drone building; aerial cinematography; drone racing; phyton for geographic information system; geographic information system for drones; disaster management with drones; drone survey and mapping; and drone in agriculture. In addition, the company offers survey, spraying, first person view, and underwater drones; and reusable rocket launch vehicle solutions and cubesat products. Further, it provides maintenance services and management consultancy services. Additionally, the companies serves defense, infrastructure, energy, utilities, agriculture, education, urban planning, mining, security, oil and gas, water bodies, insurance, environment, forest, and disaster management industries. DroneAcharya Aerial Innovations Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Pune, India.

listings.name: EARKART LIMITED
listings.about: Earkart Limited manufactures and distributes modern hearing aids and related accessories in India and internationally. The company offers adjustable foldable walkers; Multi Sensory Inclusive Educational (MSIED) Kit designed for educational purpose for mentally retarded children; Teaching Learning Material (TLM) kits to support mobility and daily needs of physically challenged; and other rehabilitation products, including their components, accessories, and parts. It also provides hearing aid test systems; BTE kit component; and zinc air battery. Additionally, the company offers after-sales services; user training; and research and development of hearing aids. Earkart Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Noida, India.

listings.name: Earthstahl & Alloys Limited
listings.about: Earthstahl & Alloys Limited produces and sells cast iron lumps, ductile iron, cast iron, steels, alloys, and non-ferrous castings in India. The company operates in two segments: Submerged Arc Furnace and Foundary. The company offers grate bars, crusher hammers, foundry grade cast iron, sockets, grate bar castings, investment castings, pump cover castings, pump cover LFC molds, sinter bars, tractor castings, railway parts, engine blocks, industrial parts and equipment, and pulleys. The company was formerly known as Earthstahl & Alloys Private Limited. Earthstahl & Alloys Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Raipur, India.

listings.name: Eighty Jewellers Limited
listings.about: Eighty Jewellers Limited engages in the trading and retail of various jewelry in India. It offers ornaments, such as rings, earrings, armlets, pendants, gajrahs, nose rings, bracelets, chains, necklaces, bangles, and other wedding jewelry, as well as watches and luxury articles made of gold, silver, diamonds, and platinum studded with precious and semi-precious stones. The company operates through a franchisee store brand Anopchand Tilokchand Jewellers. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Raipur, India.

listings.name: Ekennis Software Service Limited
listings.about: Ekennis Software Service Limited engages in software IT consulting services in India. It also provides software IT consulting and services, including ERP solutions tailored for small-scale enterprises, custom software and product development, e-commerce solutions, and specialized software training. In addition, the company offers FMCG consulting, printing, branding, and packaging services, catering to end-to-end brand development and packaging solutions, with design, consulting, and production support. Further, the company provides web development services, including business and e-commerce websites, portfolio and personal branding, blog and content platforms, appointment and booking systems, educational, nonprofit and community sites, event and launch websites, and web applications. Additionally, the company offers digital marketing services, such as social media management, advertising, search engine optimization, Google Business Profile optimization, content creation for social media, basic email marketing, and WhatsApp marketing; and FSSAI consulting, PhonePe integration, training and staffing, and barcode and QR code services. The company offers custom packaging solutions, such as 3-side seal pouches, stand-up pouches, and custom boxes. It provides packaging products under the Myperfectpack brand. Ekennis Software Service Limited was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

listings.name: Elfin Agro India Limited
listings.about: Elfin Agro India Limited manufactures and sells processed wheat flour under the Shiv Nandi and ELFIN'S Shri Shyam BHOG brands in India. The company provides high fibre whole wheat flour, refined whole wheat flour, specialized flour, semolina flour, refined flour, and yellow mustard oil. It also trades in various agro products, including chana, maize, soyabean refined oil, wheat, groundnut oil, rice bran refined oil, and cattle feed. The company serves B2B clients, wholesalers, traders, retailers, and Individual consumers. Elfin Agro India Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Bhilwara, India.

listings.name: EMIAC TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED
listings.about: Emiac Technologies Limited operates as a technology and digital solutions company in India. It develops digital growth solutions including SEO, content marketing, PR, link building, and business automation. It provides digital content writing, branding, and online reputation management, digital marketing, technical services, and business automation services. It serves digital marketing, BFSI, healthcare, IT and technology, education, automobile and many more industries. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Jaipur City, India.

listings.name: EMMFORCE AUTOTECH LIMITED
listings.about: Emmforce Autotech Limited manufactures and sells automotive drivetrain parts in India and internationally. The company offers rear axle, front axle, cardan, and power transmission shafts, as well as torsion, sway, and anti-roll bars; locking, free wheel, and floater hubs, as well as hub parts and spindles; gear shifters; hydraulic gear pumps; and differential housings, pinion and end yokes, pinion support, and shims/shim kits. It also provides lunch box and differential Posi lockers; nodular iron differential covers; full and mini spools; axle bearing pullers clam shell style products, carrier and pinion bearing pullers, axle bearing pullers plate style, and differential housing spreaders, as well as various forged and cast differential parts for 4-wheel drive and high-performance racing vehicles. In addition, the company offers engineering solutions, including conceptualization, development, validation, implementation, and manufacturing of products. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Emmforce Inc. and changed its name to Emmforce Autotech Limited in October 2023. Emmforce Autotech Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Solan, India.

listings.name: EP BIOCOMPOSITES LIMITED
listings.about: EP Biocomposites Limited manufactures and sells fibre reinforced polymere products in India. The company offers bio-digester toilets, sewage and effluent treatment plants, fibre reinforced polymer (FRP) doors, fire doors, and laminated doors; and passive fire protection products, including fire rated cable coating system and electrical/plumbing shaft sealing.
