listings.name: H.M. ELECTRO MECH LIMITED
listings.about: H.M. Electro Mech Limited engages in the supply, installation, testing, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of pumping machineries in India. The company offers engineering, procurement, and construction services for water supply projects, including construction of water treatment plant (WTP); and civil work for pump houses, diesel generating sets, panel room, instrumentation, and PLC-SCADA. It also engages in the business of electromechanical contract for water supply, wastewater treatment, and pumping machinery installation works. In addition, the company sells pumps, pipes, transformers, motors, and other electronic accessories. It serves state and central governments, municipal corporations, banking sectors, corporate companies, and educational institutes. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: HORIZON RECLAIM (INDIA) LIMITED
listings.about: Horizon Reclaim (India) Limited manufactures and supplies reclaimed rubber in India. The company offers reclaimed rubber in three main categories: natural rubber reclaim, produced from rubber tyre casings and tubes commonly used in footwear soles, floor mats, tyre base layers, and moulded rubber products; synthetic rubber reclaim, which includes EPDM and butyl reclaim rubber suitable for applications requiring resistance to oil, heat, and weather, such as automotive seals, hoses, gaskets, and construction profiles; and crumb rubber, made from recycled tyres and used in road construction, sport surfaces, and construction materials like roofing sheets. It serves the automotive, footwear, sports surfaces, flooring and mats, and construction industries. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Saharanpur, India.

listings.name: H. R. HYGIENE PRODUCTS LIMITED
listings.about: H.R. Hygiene Products Limited manufactures and distributes absorbent intimate hygiene products in India. The company's products include sanitary napkins, adult diapers for female healthcare, adult care, and baby care areas. The company operates under the brand names of Femiss, Womanica, ElderFit, and Bloom Baby. It distributes its products through trade networks and e-commerce platforms. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Rajkot, India.

listings.name: HRS ALUGLAZE LIMITED
listings.about: HRS Aluglaze Limited engages in the business of design, manufacturing, and installation of a diverse range of aluminum-based architectural products in Gujarat, Telangana, and Maharashtra. The company offers a wide range of aluminium products, including windows, doors, curtain walls, cladding, and glazing systems. The company's services include design, engineering, fabrication, supply, installation, and final handover of aluminum and glass systems. It also engages in supply and installation of façade works, aluminum doors and windows, and related solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial structures. It caters to builders, contractors, architect, and institutions for commercial, residential, industrial, and institutional projects including hospitals. HRS Aluglaze Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Hemant Surgical Industries Limited
listings.about: Hemant Surgical Industries Limited manufactures, markets, imports, and exports surgical products, healthcare products & medical equipment and pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. The company offers healthcare & surgical disposables, includes jms meditape, infusion sets, scap vein set, blood transfusion set, pediatric iv, burette set, safecath silicone foley catheter, endotracheal tube, latex foley catheter, feather skin grafting blade, aero skin stapler, aero plus ecg electrodes, digital thermometer, nebulizer, and oxygen concentrator; and dialysis products, such as dialysis machine, refurbish dialysis machine, heparin, diaclean, citro h, iron sucrose injection, dialyzer, bicart, bibag, bloodline tubing, infusion set, bicarbonate mixture, ro plant, water tank, dialysis bed, dialysis chair, refurb ng dialysis machine, av fistula, on & off kit, lumen catheter, and hemodialysis concentrator. The company also offers radiology & criticare products, such as ultrasouch machine, digital radiography machine, X-ray machine, anesthesia machine, multipara monitor, ecg machine, defibrillator, and icu ventilator; and opthalmology products, including galilean and prismatic loupe, spot illuminator, surgical camera, ttl loupe, light source, slit lamp microscope, and operating microscope. In addition, the company offers surgical disposables, such as meditapes, intravenous infusion sets, and oximeters. Further, it provides a turnkey dialysis center, imaging and diagnostic center, modular intensive care unit, modular operation theater, oncology labs and treatment centers, blood bank, and dental clinic setup services. Hemant Surgical Industries Limited was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: ICODEX PUBLISHING SOLUTIONS LIMITED
listings.about: Icodex Publishing Solutions Limited provides software solutions to the scholarly and academic publishing industries in India. It offers Innovative Comprehensive Automated Publishing Platform, a cloud-based publishing workflow solution that streamlines the publishing process through the workflow and communication management, data transfer, and data storage; PaperPerfect, a manuscript refinement platform designed to support researchers, universities, and research institutions; eAssistant, a manuscript assessment system to meet publisher and journal-level requirements; and iProof, an online review and editing platform. The company also provides FlexyPage, an advanced HTML-based online layout processing system; Intelligent Mechanical and Technical Editing System, which is designed to convert word manuscripts into structured XML; iLang, an advanced language assessment and editing platform; iRef, an automated reference management platform that verifies, updates, and restructures references based on the required style; Product Data Hub and MetaScholar, which manages product and production specifications throughout the entire life cycle of an article or book; iPublish, a cloud-based digital library designed for the dissemination of publishing content; and ieBooks for digitizing books into popular formats, such as Kindle, Mobi, and iBook applications. In addition, it offers iDigit, an OCR system designed to create JATS XML from editable PDFs; and iWrite, a manuscript writing platform for researchers. Further, the company provides business process management services that support the publishing process with activities, including quality assurance checks, and editorial and back-end support services; and IT support services. It serves publishers, institutions and societies, researches and authors, and service providers. Icodex Publishing Solutions Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Pune, India.

listings.name: Icon Facilitators Limited
listings.about: Icon Facilitators Limited provides technical facilities management services to commercial, retail, industrial, and residential customers in India. Its services include electrical system management operation, captive power management, STP/ETP and water treatment, HVAC management, building management system operation, fire and safety equipment operation, elevators and escalators operation and maintenance, and annual maintenance of E and M equipment. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in New Delhi, India.

listings.name: Identixweb Limited
listings.about: Identixweb Limited operates as an information technology company that provides and delivers software as a service-based digital product solution worldwide. Its services include e-commerce store development, web application development, UI/UX design, website development, customized software development, and support and maintenance with a focus on Shopify application development. Identixweb Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Surat, India.

listings.name: Indobell Insulations Limited
listings.about: Indobell Insulation Limited operates as a manufacturer and contractor of insulation products and prefabricated thermal insulation jackets in India. The company offers ceramic and mineral fibre nodules, granulated rockwool, spray insulation, LRB mattress insulation, ceramic fiber blanket insulation, and fibreglass aerogel insulation. It also trades in LRB mattresses, ceramic fiber blankets, aluminum sheets, and prefabricated thermal insulation jackets. In addition, the company provides consultancy, engineering, fabrication and prefabrication, material supply, installation, global logistics, project management, research and development, application of insulation work, and insulation supervision services. Its products are used to insulate various applications, including homes, commercial buildings, industrial plants, and other related insulation materials. The company exports its products to Bangladesh, Germany, Taiwan, Poland, South Korea, and the United States of America. Indobell Insulation Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Kolkata, India.

listings.name: INDONG TEA COMPANY LIMITED
listings.about: Indong Tea Company Limited manufactures and sells tea in India. The company offers black tea processed by the crush/cut, tear, and curl method. It also produces and sells dairy products, such as milk, urine, and cow-dung. Indong Tea Company Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Kolkata, India.

listings.name: INDO SMC Limited
listings.about: Indo SMC Limited designs, manufactures, and supplies arrays of sheet moulding compounds, fiberglass reinforced plastic and GRP compounds, and composites. It provides distribution systems, feeder pillars, indoor transformers, low tension CTS, metering cubicles, and outdoor transformers; heavy duty tarpaulin, tarpaulin in roll, tarpaulin in size, transperent tarpulin, vergin tarpaulin, and waterproof tarpaulins tarpaulin; FRP pultrusion; tarpaulin for construction, tarpaulin tents, vermi bed, and wagon covers; chequered plates, distribution box, junction box, meter boxes, and sheet; and FRP gratting. Indo SMC Limited was formerly known as Indo SMC Private Limited and changed its name to Indo SMC Limited in August 2024. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Infinity Infoway Limited
listings.about: Infinity Infoway Limited, a Software as a Service company, provides integrated online ERP software for manufacturing, education, retail, construction, supply chain and customer relationship management, sales force, and other industries in India and internationally. Its education enterprise resource planning (ERP) products include Online Exam Software, which is designed to streamline exam management and enhance the assessment experience for educational institutions and organizations; Online Question Paper Delivery, a system used by schools, colleges, and universities to administer exams and distribute question papers to students, as well as to create question papers, schedule exams, deliver question papers, monitor exams, and manage results; and Brainzorg, a digital learning platform that provides an opportunity for students who wish to get extra help to learn and earn knowledge regarding their current education standard. The company also provides industrial ERP solutions comprising dealer, procurement, inventory, marketing, logistics, sales, order, production, store, and bank management solutions, as well as RoC, HR and payroll system, taxation and audit, import/export, customer care, account and finance, and online bank reconciliation solutions. Infinity Infoway Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Rajkot, India.

listings.name: Inflame Appliances Limited
listings.about: Inflame Appliances Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of kitchen appliances in India. The company offers liquefied petroleum gas stoves, cooktops, oven toaster grills, and sheet metal components. It also provides pyramid, curved glass, straight t-shaped, vertical, and island chimneys, as well as built-in gas hobs. The company offers its products under the Inflame brand name. The company was formerly known as Techno Engineering Corporation and changed its name to Inflame Appliances Limited in November 2017. Inflame Appliances Limited was founded in 2010 and is based in Panchkula, India.

listings.name: INFONATIVE SOLUTIONS LIMITED
listings.about: Infonative Solutions Limited develops and designs e-learning content and courseware services, providing cloud-based learning management systems products in India. The company offers bespoke e-learning solutions, e-learning consulting, courseware and off-the-shelf content, instructional design, gamification, augmented-and virtual-reality based e-learning content, software application simulations, etc. It serves education, Edtech, and government agencies with a focus on BFSI, consulting, IT/ITES, oil and gas, FMCG, etc. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in New Delhi, India.

listings.name: INNOKAIZ INDIA LIMITED
listings.about: Innokaiz India Limited provides advertising and marketing services in India. The company provides corporate travel management, gifting, and event management services. It also offers TV and accessories, appliances, mobiles and wearables, kitchen appliances, utility appliances, home theatre and speakers, laptop, tablet and accessories, gaming accessories, and personal care products through online e-commerce stores. Innokaiz India Limited was founded in 2003 and is based in Chennai, India.

listings.name: Innovative Ideals and Services (India) Limited
listings.about: Innovative Ideals and Services (India) Limited engages in installing, repairing, and trading of electronic security products and solutions in India. It offers home networking systems, intrusion alarm systems, fire alarm systems, and telecom products; and CCTV solutions, including IP cameras, HD cameras, outdoor cameras, indoor cameras, PTZ camera, dome camera, C mount camera, and DVD and NVR products under the innoeye brand name. The company also provides IP and analog VDP multi apartment systems under the Onyx and Inok brand names; wireless home automation systems under the eHomes brand name; and mobile phones under the Inoyo brand name. In addition, it offers a smart security device for women under the ArmHER brand name; QR code-based door video screening system under the DoorVi brand name; and communication and access control systems under the FERMAX brand name. Further, the company provides application development services and customized solutions to help businesses. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Innovators Facade Systems Limited
listings.about: Innovators Façade Systems Limited engages in the designing, engineering, fabrication, supply, and installation of facade systems in India. The company offers unitized structural glazing, curtail walls, frameless glass, windows and doors, railing, louvres, canopies, sky lights, dry stone cladding, ACP, HPL, and sheet cladding products; and modular partitions, cleanroom equipment, containment solutions, and pharmaceutics process equipment, as well as metal doors, such as fire-rated, clean room, and industrial doors. It primarily serves architects, general contractors, and developers. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Thane, India.

listings.name: ITCONS E-Solutions Limited
listings.about: Itcons E-Solutions Limited engages in the recruitment and staffing business in India. It provides technology solutions, such as payroll services, managed IT services, and product installation and servicing solutions. The company serves its products to the information technology, healthcare, manufacturing, oil and gas, engineering, logistics/transportation, light industrial, media, finance/accounting, administrative services/clerical, marketing/creative, and related industries, as well as state government, central government, and PSUs industries. Itcons E-Solutions Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

listings.name: JAYANT INFRATECH LIMITED
listings.about: Jayant Infratech Limited operates in the railway infrastructure development in India. listings.name: Jay Kailash Namkeen Limited
listings.about: Jay Kailash Namkeen Limited operates in the snack food market in India. The company also provides moon chips, pasta, half moon, masala wheels, and face lock fryums; tikha farali chevda farali namkeen products; and wafer products. Jay Kailash Namkeen Limited was founded in 2013 and is based in Rajkot, India.

listings.name: JD CABLES LIMITED
listings.about: JD Cables Limited manufactures cables and conductors. It serves the various state electricity boards, as well as caters to the chemicals, data centers, defense energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, metals, oil and gas, real estate, technology, telecom, and transport industries. The company distributes its products across India. JD Cables Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Kolkata, India.

listings.name: JET SOLAR LIMITED

Jet Solar Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Jhandewalas Foods Limited
listings.about: Jhandewalas Foods Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of food and dairy products in India. The company markets its products under the Naman, Godhenu, Nutri Flakes, Sweet Bites, Yumm Yoo, and Polki brands, as well as markets its products online. Jhandewalas Foods Limited was founded in 1895 and is based in Jaipur, India.

listings.name: Jigar Cables Limited
listings.about: Jigar Cables Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of electric wires and cables under the SIGMA brand in India. The company offers single core and multi core flexible, industrial power and control, submersible flat, ariel bunched, poly insulated submersible connection, and LT PVC and XLPE cables, as well as house wires. It serves chemical and pharmaceutical, building and construction, shipping and marine, food and beverage, thermal power generation, petrochemical, automobile, petroleum refinery, steel plant, electronic, electrical, hotel and real estate, ginning, textile, cement, plastic, and mining industries; turnkey electrical contractors; and hospitals and railways, as well as the Port Trust of India. Jigar Cables Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Rajkot, India.

listings.name: Jivial Industries Limited
listings.about: Jivial Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of aluminum and stainless-steel components used in railing systems in India. The company manufactures finished aluminum railings and fixtures from unfinished extruded aluminum railings and unfinished aluminum castings. Further, it manufactures several aluminum fixtures used in supporting the railings to hold glass, such as, spigot, conceal, bend, bracket, jointer, lock and endcap. The company's customers include small and medium level construction companies, wholesalers, architects, interior designers, glass providers and fabricators, and contractors for use in residential and commercial infrastructure projects. Jivial Industries Limited was founded in 2006 and is based in Rajkot, India.

listings.name: Jointeca Education Solutions Limited

It serves the government, manufacturing, publication, website development, social media marketing, automotive, healthcare, and retail and distribution industries, as well as the video making and editing for advertisement sector. Jointeca Education Solutions Limited was founded in 2001 and is based in Mathura, India.

Jonjua Overseas Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mohali, India.

listings.name: Kalyani Cast-Tech Limited
listings.about: Kalyani Cast-Tech Limited engages in the manufacturing of container, class of foundry, casting of steel and iron, and railway parts in India. listings.name: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited

The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.about: Fusion Klassroom Edutech Limited operates as an education technology company in India. The company offers a hybrid (offline-to-online) tutoring platform, providing academic coaching for students from grades 6-12 across ICSE, CBSE, and State Boards, as well as preparation for competitive exams such as JEE, NEET, CA, and CS. It provides services through education OTT platform, which provides subscription based access to a comprehensive range of academic, competitive exam, and skill-development courses. It also operates a Klassroom online academy, which included live tutoring, recorded content, tests, assessments, digital notes, examinations, and doubt-solving through digital channels. Fusion Klassroom Edutech Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: KMS Medisurgi Limited

listings.name: KOURA FINE DIAMOND JEWELRY LIMITED
listings.about: Koura Fine Diamond Jewelry Limited engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of gold and diamond jewellery in India. it offers rings, earrings, and pendant jewelries. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: KP GREEN ENGINEERING LIMITED
listings.about: KP Green Engineering Limited engages in engineering and manufacture of steel structure in India. It serves transmission, telecom, substation, isolator hybrid, solar, and highway crash service providers. KP Green Engineering Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Surat, India.

listings.name: KRATIKAL TECH LIMITED
listings.about: Kratikal Tech Limited provides cybersecurity services including vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, security compliance audits, and virtual CISO services in India and internationally. The company offers a unified AI-powered platform called Autosect, which delivers real-time vulnerability scanning and management for networks, web and mobile applications, cloud environments, and APIs. It conducts web application security testing to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, and assists organizations in developing security measures aligned with enterprise security objectives and regulatory compliance requirements. The company provides risk detection, prioritization, and vulnerability compliance tracking through customizable dashboards. It serves enterprises and small to medium-sized businesses across industries such as fintech, telecom, healthcare, e-commerce, and other sectors. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Noida, India.

listings.name: Krupalu Metals Limited
listings.about: Krupalu Metals Limited engages in manufacturing and sale of brass and copper products in India. The company offers brass and copper sheets and strips; metal components, including cutting components, inserts, pipe fittings, profiles, terminals, electrical components, bus bars, and many other customized products. It also provides various job work services; and trades in raw materials. In addition, the company offers brass sheet cutting components, brass electrical components, brass profile, brass insert, copper sheets and strips, brass sheet and strips, brass terminals, brass pipe fittings, and copper bus bar. Krupalu Metals Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Jamnagar, India.

listings.name: KVS Castings Limited
listings.about: KVS Castings Limited engages in the manufacturing and selling of cast iron and ductile iron castings in India. It serves automobiles, railways, heavy machinery and equipment, energy and power generation, infrastructure and construction, and agricultural machinery. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Kashipur, India.

listings.name: K. V. TOYS INDIA LIMITED
listings.about: K. V. Toys India Limited engages in the business of contract manufacturing and sale of plastic-molded and metal-based toys for children in India. The company offers friction-powered toys, soft bullet guns, acrylonitrile butadiene styrene toys, pullback toys, battery-operated and electronic toys, press-and-go toys, die-cast metal vehicles, bubble toys, dolls, and other play-based products. It sells its products through retail stores and online marketplace under the Alia & Olivia, Yes Motors, Funny Bubbles, and Thunder Strike band names. additionally, it manufactures stationery items and gift set. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Thane, India.

listings.name: LABELKRAFT TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED
listings.about: Labelkraft Technologies Limited provides barcode solutions in India. The company supplies barcode labels, barcode label printers, barcode ribbons, barcode scanners, adhesive tapes, POS, surface protection films, bartender software, RFID products, ID card printing products, patient wrist bands, consumables, and automatic label applicator machines, as well as satin and taffeta rolls. It serves the FMCG, logistics service providers, chemicals, and garments industries. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

listings.name: LAXMIPATI ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED
listings.about: Laxmipati Engineering Works Limited engages in the ship building and repair, fabrication, heavy engineering, engineering infrastructure and services, shut down maintenance projects, and precision machining in India. Laxmipati Engineering Works Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Surat, India.

listings.name: LEAPFROG ENGINEERING SERVICES LIMITED
listings.about: Leapfrog Engineering Services Limited engages in engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning services in India and internationally. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

listings.name: Lex Nimble Solutions Limited
listings.about: Lex Nimble Solutions Limited, a business management consulting company, provides training, consulting, and appraisal services in India and internationally. listings.name: LANDMARK GLOBAL LEARNING LIMITED

listings.name: LGT GLOBAL HOSPITALITY LIMITED
listings.about: LGT Global Hospitality Limited engages in tour packages operations and event management in India. listings.name: Logiciel Solutions Limited
listings.about: Logiciel Solutions Limited operates as an outsourced software development firm that designs, develops, and delivers custom software solutions to enterprises and startups internationally. L. T. Elevator Limited was founded in 2000 and is based in Kolkata, India.

listings.about: Mach Travel Solutions Limited provides corporate travel, events, and experiences management services in India. Malpani Pipes and Fittings Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Ratlam, India.

It sells its products through wholesalers, e-commerce platforms and website, and shop-in-shop stores. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Delhi, India.

Mayank Cattle Food Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Rajkot, India.

listings.name: Manoj Ceramic Limited
listings.about: Manoj Ceramic Limited engages in the contract manufacture, sale, and distribution of ceramic and vitrified wall and floor tiles in India and the United Kingdom. Manoj Ceramic Limited was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: MODERN DIAGNOSTIC & RESEARCH CENTRE LIMITED

The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Milestone Furniture Limited

The company offers clinical products, including adhesives, bonding agents, and etchants; auxiliaries; cement and liners; composites; endodontics; finishing and polishing; impression and retraction materials; orthodontics materials and products; temporaries; and tooth whitening products. It also provides laboratory products comprising acrylics, auxiliaries, base plates and waxes, and gypsum products; restorative, prosthetic, and hemostatic materials; preventive care products; and oral care, hygiene and disinfection products, and 3D resins. The company's products are used for endodontics, prosthodontics, periodontics, orthodontics, and restorative and aesthetic dentistry applications, as well as for the fabrication of prosthesis in dental laboratories. Prevest Denpro Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Jammu, India.

listings.name: PRODOCS SOLUTIONS LIMITED
listings.about:
Prodocs Solutions Limited engages in the IT Enabled services (ITES/BPO) business in the United States and India.
 It offers non-voice business process outsourcing services, such as title services that include title plant indexing, title search, and title production services; e-publishing services, including e-paper and e-magazines and formats; indexing and imaging that include data capture; finance and accounting; and litigation support services. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Promax Power Limited
listings.about: Promax Power Limited engages in executing turnkey power, substation, transmission line, hydro, distribution, electrification, civil construction, pre-engineered building, high rise building, and sewerage and water treatment projects in India. The company is involved in engineering, procurement, and construction projects (EPC); and provision of project management. It also executes civil infrastructure projects, such as industrial buildings; water infrastructure management projects comprising water transmission and distribution works; and solar project EPC. In addition, the company engages in substation, civil construction, pre-engineered buildings, sewerage treatment plant, and water treatment plant. Promax Power Limited was founded in 2004 and is based in Mohali, India.

listings.name: PDP Shipping & Projects Limited
listings.about: PDP Shipping & Projects Limited, an international freight forwarding company, provides shipping and logistics, and transport solutions through sea, air, rail, and road primarily in India. It offers international freight forwarding services; air and sea freight services; multimodal transportation services; custom clearance services; packaging, warehousing, transportation, and distribution services; integrated logistics solutions; and door-to-door logistic services. The company also provides breakbulk, heavy lift, and project cargo handling and shipping services; roll onroll off loadout and sea towage services; and total sea transportation engineering solutions. In addition, it offers special cargo services, including time bound shipment, exhibition cargo, and temperature critical cargo services; and over dimensional cargo handling services. The company serves heavy engineering, energy, defense, automobile, electronics, shipyards, EPC, infrastructure, FMCG, manufacturing, and other sectors. PDP Shipping & Projects Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.

listings.name: PURPLE WAVE INFOCOM LIMITED
listings.about: Purple Wave Infocom Limited designs, integrates, manages & supports on site and cloud-based communication and collaboration in India. It offers indoor and outdoor LED displays, touch and non-touch displays, digital kiosks, audio video conferencing, digital podium, and mounts and accessories, as well as consultancy, solution design, project management, and support services It serves corporate, education, and digital signage sectors; and homes and governments under the Streampurple, Saipur, Nano Theater, and The IVY brands. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in New Delhi, India.

listings.name: Qualitek Labs Limited
listings.about: Qualitek Labs Limited offers technical testing and analysis services in India and internationally. The company offers inspection, certification, homologation, research and development, training programs, audit, and consultancy services. It serves automobiles, defence, electronics and electricals, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, metals, minerals, environment monitoring, food, and water industries. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Noida, India. Qualitek Labs Limited is a subsidiary of TIC Services Private Limited.

listings.name: Quality RO Industries Limited
listings.about: Quality RO Industries Limited manufactures and supplies water treatment products in India. It operates through Reverse-Osmosis (RO) Products, Transport Income, Realty Sector, and Others segments. The company offers dolphin and jug taps, kent products, membrane housings, PP spun filters, and RO bowls; and water softener equipment, such as RO filter parts, cartridges, and membranes. It also provides die casting and associated contractual manufacturing services, as well as RO equipment spares and associated products. In addition, the company offers contractual logistics services; and develops residential and commercial properties. Quality RO Industries Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Vadodara, India.

listings.name: QUEST FLOW CONTROLS LIMITED
listings.about: Quest Flow Controls Limited assembles, buys, sells, distributes, imports, exports, or deals in valves, actuators, strainers, and remote-control valves systems to various industries in India and internationally. The company engages in manufacturing of special purpose machinery. It also deals in products, such as control cabinets, tanks, visualization systems, piping products, pumps, fittings, gaskets, flanges, and measurement devices. In addition, the company engages in the installation, maintaining, servicing, or handling of equipment and services that control and manage its products. Further, it offers butterfly, gate, and globe valve; quick closing tools, IPMS-compatible valves, and type-tested alloy steel valves. Additionally, the company provides flow control technology services comprising end-to-end capabilities, design engineering, component sourcing, in-house machining and hydro-testing, assembly, distribution, installation, and aftersales service. It supplies its products primarily to naval, oil and gas, power, refineries, and general industries. The company was formerly known as Meson Valves India Limited and changed its name to Quest Flow Controls Limited in June 2025. Quest Flow Controls Limited was founded in 2003 and is based in Pune, India.

listings.name: Rachit Prints Limited
listings.about: Rachit Prints Limited manufactures and sells specialty fabrics for mattresses in India. The company offers knitted fabrics, printed fabrics, warp knit fabrics, pillow fabrics, and binding tapes. It also trades in comforters and bedsheets. Rachit Prints Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Meerut, India.

listings.name: RACONTEUR GLOBAL RESOURCES LIMITED
listings.about: Raconteur Global Resources Limited engages in export and import of minerals. It also deals in waste and by products arising from the mining or processing of all types of stones. The company was formerly known as Ganesh Films India Limited and changed its name to Raconteur Global Resources Limited in December 2023. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India. Raconteur Global Resources Limited operates as a subsidiary of Annaya Management Consultancy Private Limited.

listings.name: Raghuvansh Agrofarms Limited
listings.about: Raghuvansh Agrofarms Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing and trading of agro products in India. The company offers organic vegetables; organic grains and cereals; cow and buffalo milk, and dairy products; organic wheatgrass and manure; aeroponic potatoes; and vermicompost and ornamental plants. It is also engaging in the cultivation of fruits, as well as has orchards of pomegranate, guava, banana, etc. In addition, the company operates a bio-gas power plant. Raghuvansh Agrofarms Limited was founded in 1995 and is based in Kanpur, India.

listings.name: RAJESH POWER SERVICES LIMITED
listings.about: Rajesh Power Services Limited provides engineering, procurement, and construction contracting and services to power transmission and distribution utilities companies in India. The company undertakes turnkey projects for EHV cables and transmission lines, EHV substations, MV/HV/LV distribution systems, and solar projects; and offers operation and maintenance services for EHV substations and solar plants. It also provides utility services, including underground cable fault location and rectification of EHV/MV/HV/LV networks; replacement/retrofitting of transformers and switch gears; cable laying and jointing; and substation maintenance and up keeping. In addition, the company offers testing of switch yard equipment, such as power transformers scheme testing, tan delta measurement, contact resistance measurement of EHV isolators and breakers, primary injection testing of CTs, and relay testing, as well as EHV/MV/HV/LV cable testing services. Further, it provides EHV cable system design and substation design; design of distribution networks, selection of cable size, transformer rating, calculation of voltage drop, and calculation of losses in distribution networks; site survey and preparation of detailed project report; consultancy for electrical projects; and inspection services for equipment. Rajesh Power Services Limited was founded in 1971 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Resourceful Automobile Limited
listings.about: Resourceful Automobile Limited operates as an authorized dealer of Yamaha that sells two-wheeler bikes under the Sawhney Automobiles showroom name in India. The company provides commuter bikes, sport bikes, cruisers, and scooters. It also engages in the sale of spare parts; and maintenance and repairs of motorcycles and scooters. Resourceful Automobile Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in New Delhi, India.

listings.name: Ranjeet Mechatronics Limited
listings.about: Ranjeet Mechatronics Limited provides pipe fabrication and jointing products primarily in India. The company offers installation, designing, commissioning, testing, maintenance, and support for turnkey projects. It provides fire protection and detection systems, such as smoke detection and fire alarm, fire hydrant, fire sprinkler, water mist fire protection, deluge, gaseous fire suppression, and high sensitive smoke detection systems, as well as fire rated doors and fire extinguishers. In addition, the company offers electronic surveillance and security systems, including access control, CCTV, public address and voice alarm, and integrated building management systems. Further, it provides end suction, split case, multistage, special and engineered, monobloc, submersible, and sump pumps; butterfly, sluice, non-return, kinetic air, foot, FM approved gate, suction diffuser and triple duty, and ball valves, as well as cast steel and forged steel gate, globe, and check valves; and pumps, motors, engines, valves, and firefighting accessories and equipment. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: RAPID MULTIMODAL LOGISTICS LIMITED
listings.about: Rapid Multimodal Logistics Limited provides specialized transportation and logistics services across road, rail, sea, inland waterways, and air in India and internationally. The company operates a fleet of trucks, trailers, tankers, vessels, and aircraft to transport goods and cargo; and acts as a clearing and forwarding agent. It also provides road freight services comprising client consultation, route planning, booking and scheduling, loading and packaging, en route management, unloading and delivery, documentation and reporting, and post-delivery support services; rail freight services, which include route optimization, cargo loading and securement, intermodal connectivity, and unloading and last-mile delivery coordination; and coastal shipment services, such as port handling and documentation and last-mile connectivity services. The company serves the iron and steel, paper, FMCG, glass, construction material manufacturing, pharmaceutical, chemical, and other industries. Rapid Multimodal Logistics Limited was founded in 2005 and is based in Chennai, India.

listings.name: Ravelcare Limited
listings.about: Ravelcare Limited provides beauty and personal care products in India. The company offers haircare products, which includes shampoos, conditioners, hair masks, hair oils, and styling products; skincare products comprising face cleansers, serums, moisturizers, sunscreens, and concern specific treatments; body care products, such as body washes and body lotions; and scalp care products, which consists of anti-dandruff scalp tonic and hair growth serum. It sells its products through its website and e-commerce websites. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Rajeshwari Cans Limited
listings.about: Rajeshwari Cans Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of tin containers for ink and color manufacturing units in India. It offers tin containers of various sizes used for packing of tobacco and snuff; and job printing over aluminum sheets for manufacturers of PP Cap and advertising boards. The company is also involved in packaging industry. Rajeshwari Cans Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Riddhi Display Equipments Limited
listings.about: Riddhi Display Equipments Limited manufactures and sells display and kitchen equipment in India and internationally. It offers display counter for restaurants, food courts, cafes, retail shops, supermarket, ice cream parlours, cake and pastry shops, etc. The company also provides commercial kitchen equipment, such as tea snacks services trolley, tilting type bulk cooker, hot bain marie, plaza oven, salamander, sandwich griller, single burner and two burner cooking range, four burner continental range, tandoor, dish landing table with garbage chute, pot rack, wall shelf, exhaust hoods, dough kneading machine, tilting wet masala grinder, pulveriser, and work table and trolly; and commercial refrigeration equipment for hotels, restaurant, canteen, hospitals, hostel, temple, etc. Riddhi Display Equipments Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Gondal, India.

listings.name: RUKMANI DEVI GARG AGRO IMPEX LIMITED
listings.about: Rukmani Devi Garg Agro Impex Limited engages in the trading of agricultural commodities in India. It trades in wheat, mustard, coriander, maize, flax seeds, soyabean, mustard oil, paddy, soyabean refine oil, mustard de-oiled cakes, gram, refined flour, makka, agri-seeds, etc. The company is also involved in the manufacturing of edible oils, such as soyabean oil and mustard oil, as well as processing of raw wheat. Rukmani Devi Garg Agro Impex Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Kota, India.

listings.name: RECODE STUDIOS LIMITED
listings.about: Recode Studios Limited engages in the designing, producing, managing, and sale of beauty and cosmetics products in India. The company offers everyday makeup, face, lipsticks, foundations and concealers, palettes, powders, eyelashes and glitters, brushes, eyes, lip tint balm blusher, face washes and body care, and saver combo products. It sells its products under the Recode brand through stores and online channels. Recode Studios Limited was founded in 2018 and is based in Ludhiana, India.

listings.name: REETECH INTERNATIONAL LIMITED
listings.about: Reetech International Limited engages in the trade, export, and import of coal and other natural resources. It imports coal from Indonesia, South Africa, Australia, India, and other countries. The company supplies its coal to power, steel, rolling, and other industries. It distributes through sea, rail, and road mode. The company was formerly known as Reetech International Cargo and Courier Limited and changed its name to Reetech International Limited in April 2025. Reetech International Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Raipur, India.

listings.name: REPONO LIMITED
listings.about: Repono Limited provides operations and maintenance, consultancy, design and engineering, transportation, and specialized warehousing services in India and internationally. It offers technical and logistics solutions. The company also operates petroleum, oil, lubricants, crude oil terminals, and chemical tanks, as well as provides specialty chemicals for industries. It serves oil and gas, petrochemical, lube oil, and specialty chemical industries. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.

listings.name: RESGEN LIMITED
listings.about: ResGen Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of pyrolysis oil and carbon from plastic waste and plastic scrap in India. The company's pyrolysis oil is a substitute for furnace oil. It also produces by-products, such as carbon and gas; and sells valves. The company was formerly known as Ecojanitors Limited and changed its name to ResGen Limited in July 2022. ResGen Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Retaggio Industries Limited
listings.about: Retaggio Industries Limited engages in the production and sale of jewellery products in India. It operates through precious metal jewellery, gemstones and diamond trading, luxury artifacts, and timepieces and accessories. The company provides necklaces, bracelets, earrings, rings, and other ornaments. It also offers gold, silver, platinum, and other precious metals, as well as alloys; diamonds, rubies, emeralds, and pearls; cutlery, watches, clocks, antiques, paintings, and manuscripts; and Sourcing, grading, and retailing of cut and polished diamonds and other precious stones. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Retina Paints Limited
listings.about: Retina Paints Limited manufactures and sells paints in India. It offers distempers, primers, wall finishes, emulsions, spray plasters, putty, etc. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

listings.name: Rex Sealing and Packing Industries Limited
listings.about: Rex Sealing and Packing Industries Limited manufactures and sells sealing, packing, and insulation products in India and internationally. The company offers compressed non asbestos jointing sheets, such as steam, high pressure steam, oil, special oil, and acid jointing sheets; and gland packing products comprising PTFE fiber, synthetic PTFE fiber, PTFE graphite, pure aramid fiber, pure graphite, GFO, aramid + GFO fiber, PTFE aramid, PTFE graphite gland, pure carbon with graphite, ultra-pure graphite fiber, and carbonaceous aramid fiber packing products. It also provides fabric expansion joints, insulation jackets, ceramic fiber products, fire resistant sleeves and mattes, tadpole gaskets, graphite sheets and rings, and vermiculite coated cloth; ropes and high temperature resistant textiles; and silica and silicone products, such as silica tape with adhesive, silica cloth, high temperature silica products, silica fabrics, and insulating silica fabrics. The company serves the petrochemical, power, cement, steel, chemical, pharmaceutical, gas, and process industries. It also exports its products to various industries in the United Kingdom, the United States, Europe, Australia, Africa, and the Middle East. Rex Sealing and Packing Industries Limited was founded in 1963 and is based in Raigad, India.

listings.name: Rajnandini Fashion India Limited
listings.about: Rajnandini Fashion India Limited engages in the design, manufacturing and sale of women's apparel. The company offers ethnic wear, including ethnic sets, kurtas, kurta sets with dupattas, patiala salwar suits, unstitched dress materials, sarees, tops, such as cotton tops, crop tops, tunics, and western tops, dresses, such as mini dresses, long dresses, maternity dresses, co-ord sets, plus-size apparel, and a Rajnandini exclusive collection under the brand names Merira, Monira, Roly Poly, and Rajnandini. The company caters to individual consumers and business partners, serving B2C customers through its own website and e-commerce platforms, such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, LimeRoad, and Nykaa, and direct-to-consumer sales across India; and under the B2B segment, it supplies unstitched and semi-stitched fabrics as well as ready-to-wear garments to channel partners and garment processors through wholesale and direct distribution channels. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Surat, India.

listings.name: Rikhav Securities Limited
listings.about: Rikhav Securities Limited operates as a managed shares and stocks broking company in India. It engages in the equity broking, investing, and trading activities. The company also provides brokering services for equity derivatives, such as index futures, index options, individual stock futures, individual stock options, and currency futures; IPOs; equity segment through its corporate office and branches/franchisees; commodity and cash derivatives, as well as operates as a depository participant; and Rikhav Plus mobile trading application. In addition, it offers margin trading facility, commodity broking, proprietary trading, market making, mutual fund distribution, digital onboarding, and clearing services. The company serves high net-worth individuals (HNIs), corporates, institutional, and retail clients. Rikhav Securities Limited was formerly known as Brijmohan Sagarmal Finance Limited and changed its name to Rikhav Securities Limited in February 2006. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Rithwik Facility Management Services Limited
listings.about: Rithwik Facility Management Services Limited provides facilities management and turnkey solutions in India. The company offers building maintenance services, including cleaning, painting, repairing broken items, roofing repairs, waterproofing services, and annual maintenance for building equipment; and electrical maintenance services, including power backup, preventive maintenance visits, reactive callout service, electrical repairs, emergency lighting, periodic testing, maintenance, and repairs. It also provides security services comprising security measures, access control systems, surveillance cameras, intrusion detection systems, regular security audits, security protocol development, and staff training; HVAC maintenance consisting of HVAC maintenance, system specific expertise, a preventative approach, and air conditioning services; and housekeeping services which include window and blind cleaning, ceiling wall and floor cleaning, fire and food clean-up, special event support, pest control, restroom cleaning, workspace sanitization, and trash removal. In addition, the company offers office fitout, renovation, and workspace services, as well as interior fit-out. The company was formerly known as Rithwik Building Services Private Limited. Rithwik Facility Management Services Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Chennai, India.

listings.name: Riyaasat Lifestyle Limited
listings.about: Riyaasat Lifestyle Limited designs, manufactures, and sells traditional and ethnic Indian clothing for men and women in India. The company through its brand Riyaasat offers men's wear, such as sherwani suit, kurta jacket set, indo-western menswear, tuxedo, jodhpuri suit, festive wear; women's wear, including sarees, indo-western, salwar suit, lehengas, ready-to-wear sarees, gown, anarkali sets, co-ord sets; and occasion wear includes collections for weddings, haldi, mehendi, sangeet, cocktails, and receptions for both men and women. It sells its products through brand outlets, key accounts, distributors and online channels, including its own website and online marketplaces. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Macfos Limited
listings.about: Macfos Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates an e-commerce platform for electronic products in India. The company offers development boards; drone parts; batteries, power supply, and accessories; 3D printers and parts; sensors modules; electronic components; motors, drivers, pumps, and actuators; electronic modules and displays; IoT and wireless modules; mechanical parts, measurement, and workbench tools; DIY and maker kits; and electric vehicle parts. It also provides robot making kits, e-bike accessories, microcontrollers, wheels, chassis, carbon fiber and DIY products, and other mechanical and electronic components. In addition, the company provides FDM and SLA 3D printing, prototyping, mechanical and electronic assembly, lithium-ion battery pack assembly, PCB manufacturing, and metal and non-metal laser cutting services, as well as same day shipping and customer services. It sells its products under the SmartElex, EasyMech, SimplyFly, and ProRange brands. The company serves manufacturers, industries, educational institutions, researchers, and developers. Macfos Limited was founded in 2012 and is based in Pune, India.

listings.name: Roni Households Limited
listings.about: Roni Households Limited trades in plastic granules and plastic household products in India. It operates through Trading in Agriculture Product and Manufacturing of Plastic Product segments. The company also manufactures and trades in tubs, buckets, office furniture, and ghamelas, etc. In addition, the company produces plastic granules. Roni Households Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Jalgaon, India.

listings.name: Roopshri Resorts Limited
listings.about: Roopshri Resorts Limited, a hospitality company, engages in the hotel and lodging business in India. It operates a hotel under the Hotel Alexander name in Matheran, Maharashtra. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: Royal Sense Limited
listings.about: Royal Sense Limited engages in supplying various surgical accessories, tools, equipment, and other pharmaceutical products under the STERGIC brand name. It offers medical equipment, surgical instruments and consumables, laboratory equipment and reagents, medical consumables, diagnostics tools, sanitary products, pharmaceuticals, medicine, and cosmetics, as well as disposables. The company serves hospitals, laboratories, institutions, and clinics. Royal Sense Limited was founded in 2015 and is based in New Delhi, India.

listings.name: Riddhi Steel and Tube Limited
listings.about: Riddhi Steel and Tube Limited engages in the manufacture, dealing, and trading of steel and tube pipes under the RIDDHI brand in India and internationally. It offers round, and square and rectangular hollow sections MS ERW black pipes; galvanized pipes and tubes; and pre-galvanized pipes and tubes. The company serves solar power; power plant; agriculture; roadways and highways; green house; scaffolding and infrastructure; fire and safety; construction; irrigation; railway infrastructure; petrochemicals; water supply; telecommunication and transmission towers; metro and BRTS stations; and oil and gas industries. The company exports its products. Riddhi Steel and Tube Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Rudra Gas Enterprise Limited
listings.about: Rudra Gas Enterprise Limited engages in the provision of end-to-end solutions for city gas distribution sector in India. The company is involved in gas distribution network projects, such as PNG domestic connection; commercial natural gas connection; industrial natural gas connection; operation and maintenance of gas pipeline network; fiber cable network project, including liaison of RoU & RoW permission; HDPE duct laying; manhole installations; fibre cable blowing; splicing; optical time domain reflector; LSPM; operation and maintenance of fiber networks; and mobile / wifi tower erection. It also engages in renting of construction machinery and vehicles verticals. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Sodhani Academy of Fintech Enablers Limited
listings.about: Sodhani Academy of Fintech Enablers Limited, a technology-led, hybrid education firm, engages in the training and learning business in India. The company offers learning and training solution, such as personal finance, investment and portfolio management, basic financial planning, basic banking and financial services knowledge, financial literacy for youth and women, corporate training, and SIP education and awareness courses. It also provides online/live sessions, digital modules, offline seminars, and certification courses. In addition, the company is involved in manufacturing of agricultural products. It serves students, fresh graduates, homemakers, and aspiring retail investors seeking knowledge in financial planning, stock market fundamentals, trading strategies, and wealth management. The company was formerly known as Sodhani Financial Consultants Limited and changed its name to Sodhani Academy of Fintech Enablers Limited in May 2023. Sodhani Academy of Fintech Enablers Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Jaipur, India.

listings.name: Safecure Services Limited
listings.about: Safecure Services Limited provides private security, e-surveillance, and facility management services in India. It offers security Services, such as manned guarding services, mobile patrols, CCTV monitoring, alarm response, event security, and risk assessment and management; facility management services, including repair and maintenance of ATMs, cleaning and janitorial services, maintenance and repairs, waste management, landscaping and groundskeeping, and HVAC and electrical systems management; and e-surveillance services, such as monitored intrusion alarm system and services. The company also provides corporate interior fit outs work comprising project planning and management, planning and designing, procurement and handling logistics, implementation / installation, testing and commissioning, and handover and training. It serves banks, corporate, educational institutions, residential complexes, industrial facilities, healthcare institutions, and retail and commercial establishments. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Thane, India.

listings.name: SAILANI TOURS N TRAVELS LIMITED
listings.about: Sailani Tours N Travels Limited provides travel and related services in India. It offers ticketing, hotels, domestic and international packages, MICE, forex, and visa and insurance services, as well as customized itineraries for popular and offbeat destinations. The company also sells its products through online. Sailani Tours N Travels Limited was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Kolkata, India.

listings.name: SAMPAT ALUMINIUM LIMITED
listings.about: Sampat Aluminium Limited engages in the manufacturing, processing, and trading of aluminium related products in India. The company offers aluminium long products, includes aluminium wires and aluminium rods through the procurement of aluminium ingots, rods, wires and recycling of aluminium scrap. It manufactures a range of cast and hot-rolled aluminium products. It serves electrical power, construction, manufacturing, building wiring, and steel industries. Sampat Aluminium Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.

listings.name: Sancode Technologies Limited
listings.about: Sancode Technologies Limited, a software and product development company, operates an API enabled platform to adopt technology applications in India and internationally. The company develops, provides, undertakes, designs, distributes, and deals in systems and application software. It offers cloud migration, robotic process automation, machine learning, offshore software development, and other solutions. In addition, the company provides workflow automation, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, metaverse, system integration, web3 applications, and data analytics solutions. Sancode Technologies Limited serves enterprise solutions software, resource planning, e-commerce, value added products, Internet, and Intranet website applications, and other business applications for corporations. The company was formerly known as ZNL Startup Advisory Pvt. Ltd. and changed its name to Sancode Technologies Limited in January 2023. Sancode Technologies Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Mumbai, India.

listings.name: SATTRIX INFORMATION SECURITY LIMITED
listings.about: Sattrix Information Security Limited provides information security solutions and related services internationally. The company offers security solutions, such as incident response, automation and response, device management, helpdesk and tech support, IT infrastructure support, compliance, detection and response, and vulnerability management. It also provides strategic advisory and implementation support, including technology consulting and transportation, and IT cost optimization; security assessment services comprising vulnerability and infrastructure assessments, penetration testing, application audit, code review, and assessment and advisory services. In addition, the company offers cybersecurity expert services comprising compliance, SOAR, and IR as a service, as well as hybrid SOC management, SIEM consulting, and MSS for the stockbrokers' community. Further, it provides Splunk, Palo Alto, Fortinent, Cortex, NewEvol, ArcSight, Zoho, and Google security operations solutions. Sattrix Information Security Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: SBL Infratech Limited
listings.about: SBL Infratech Limited is engaged in the business of real estate development activities. Its primary business is development of residential, commercial, retail properties and project management. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: Sanghvi Brands Limited
listings.about: Sanghvi Brands Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manages and operates spa, and beauty and salons under the Spa L'OCCITANE, Elle Spa & Salon, Warren Tricomi Salon & Spa name in India, the Middle East, Maldives, Mauritius, Seychelles, and Sri Lanka. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Pune, India.

listings.name: Shri Balaji Valve Components Limited
listings.about: Shri Balaji Valve Components Limited engages in the manufacturing of ready-to-assemble valve components in India, Africa, Asia, North America, South America, Europe, Australia, and internationally. The company offers ball, butterfly, and gate valve components; stem, actuator stem, spline shaft, trunnion plate, packing gland, body adaptor, stem housing, body, one piece TMBV ball, bonnet, seat ring, spring button, lifting lug, plug, gear box flange, ISO pad, and sleeve; and forging products, such as bonnet, clamp, coupling, eblow, hinges, eblow tee, inner ring, ISO pad, trunnion and plate, and ball. It serves oil and gas, petrochemical, power generation, pharmaceutical, and defense sectors. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Pune, India.

listings.name: Scarnose International Limited
listings.about: Scarnose International Limited engages in the manufacturing, trading, warehousing, clearing, forwarding, purchasing, selling, and marketing of active pharmaceutical ingredients in India. It also provides oncology drugs, antibiotics, vaccines, pharmaceutical formulations, personal hygiene products, fertilizers, and agricultural chemicals. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Rajkot, India.

listings.name: SAFETY CONTROLS & DEVICES LIMITED
listings.about: Safety Controls & Devices Limited engaged in the engineering, procurement, and construction business in India. The company engages in the installation of substations, construction of solar plants, installation of firefighting equipment, construction projects of hospital. It operates in multiple sectors including transmission and distribution, solar energy, EV charging infrastructure, fire protection systems, and hospital construction. It engages in designing, engineering, supplying, installing, erecting, testing, and commissioning transmission substations. listings.name: Shashwat Furnishing Solutions Limited

listings.name: SILVERSTORM PARKS AND RESORTS LIMITED

listings.name: Safa Systems & Technologies Limited

Stanbik Agro Limited was founded in 2010 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: STELLAR CAPITAL SERVICES LIMITED

listings.name: SUGS LLOYD LIMITED
